一维 Burgers 方程的离散伴随：格心格式

Discrete adjoints for one-dimensional Burgers: cell-centred scheme

算例是区间 [0,1][0,1] 上带源项的一维 Burgers 方程：左端给定入口值，右端流出，未知量放在单元中心。本页先介绍方程和它的作用，再建立网格，然后从一个面上的通量出发，依次写出残差、前向（tangent）与伴随（adjoint），最后用它们计算源项和入口值的灵敏度。每个面循环都可以逐步播放；切换一阶与二阶，可以看到重构怎样改变计算模板和收敛精度。The test case is the one-dimensional Burgers equation with a source on [0,1][0,1]: a prescribed inlet value on the left, outflow on the right, and unknowns at cell centres. After introducing the equation, what it is for and the mesh, this page starts with the flux on one face and builds the residual, the forward (tangent) and the adjoint, then uses them to compute sensitivities to the source and inlet value. Each face loop can be played step by step. Switching between first and second order shows how reconstruction changes the stencil and accuracy.

阅读范围：教学主线与研究性选读

Reading scope: core teaching and optional research

本项目以离散伴随教学为主。第 1–15、17–18 节构成从残差、tangent、adjoint 到梯度验证与线性求解的主线；第 16 节先了解“离散导数正确”与“连续极限正确”的区别即可。附录 A、C 是连续参考与直接法的进阶教学，附录 B 的守恒离散、链式求导和固定网格验证也是进阶教学。

The teaching core is Sections 1–15 and 17–18: residuals, tangents, adjoints, gradient checks and linear solves. In Section 16, first distinguish correct discrete derivatives from a correct continuum limit. Appendices A and C teach continuous references and direct solves; conservation, chain-rule differentiation and fixed-grid checks in Appendix B are also advanced teaching.

以下标记只表示超出首次学习的研究性分析范围，不表示首次提出、学术空白或已经证明的新结论。可以跳过这些分析而完整学习离散伴随。附录 D.1 的分支切换、D.2 的链式法则是已知概念；研究性部分是把特定数值观察推广为收敛规律。

The labels identify analysis beyond a first course, not novelty, a literature gap or a newly proved result. These parts can be skipped without missing the discrete-adjoint method. Branch switching in D.1 and the chain rule in D.2 are established concepts; generalising particular observations into convergence laws is the research-oriented part.

第 1 节Section 1

方程：一维定常 Burgers 方程

The equation: steady one-dimensional Burgers

从守恒律到定常方程

From a conservation law to the steady equation

一维 Burgers 方程是最简单的非线性守恒律。把 u(x,t)u(x,t) 看作沿 xx 方向输运的一个量：一段区间里 uu 的总量，只因两端的通量 F(u)=u2/2F(u)=u^2/2 和区间内的源项 s(x)s(x) 而改变。写成微分形式，就是

The one-dimensional Burgers equation is the simplest nonlinear conservation law. Think of u(x,t)u(x,t) as a quantity carried along xx: the amount of uu in an interval changes only through the flux F(u)=u2/2F(u)=u^2/2 at its two ends and the source s(x)s(x) inside it. In differential form,

ut+(u22)x=s(x).u_t+\left(\frac{u^2}{2}\right)_x=s(x).

按乘积法则，(u2/2)x=u ux(u^2/2)_x=u\,u_x：uu 以自己的值为速度被输运。u uxu\,u_x 正是流体动量方程里的非线性对流项。本页只研究定常解。令 ut=0u_t=0，得到要在 [0,1][0,1] 上离散的方程和它的入口条件：

By the product rule, (u2/2)x=u ux(u^2/2)_x=u\,u_x: uu is carried along at a speed equal to its own value. The term u uxu\,u_x is exactly the nonlinear convection term of the momentum equation of fluid flow. This page studies steady solutions only. Setting ut=0u_t=0 gives the equation to be discretised on [0,1][0,1] and its inlet condition:

ddx(u22)=s(x),x∈[0,1],u(0)=uin.\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u^2}{2}\right)=s(x),\quad x\in[0,1],\qquad u(0)=u_{in}.

我们研究光滑正解分支 u>0u>0 上的解。本例不含激波，所以第 3 节的二阶格式使用无斜率限制器的线性重构；间断和激波留到附录 B。

We study solutions on the smooth positive branch u>0u>0. This example has no shocks, so the second-order scheme of Section 3 uses unlimited linear reconstruction; discontinuities and shocks are left to Appendix B.

图 1把这个问题画在一张图上：当前设计，离散解取本页默认的 N=8N=8、一阶（单元平均值，画在单元中心）。下半部分是源项：8 根柱是当前设计的常值 σk=0.5\sigma_k=0.5，虚线是目标源项 sin⁡(πx)\sin(\pi x)。上半部分是解：实线是精确解 u=1+xu=\sqrt{1+x}，圆点是本页算出的离散解（第 2 节起讲怎样算），虚线是目标场 utgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}。两部分之间的箭头是各处的波速 uu：全部指向右，并随 uu 增大而变长。入口 x=0x=0 给定 uin=1u_{in}=1；出口 x=1x=1 不给条件。

Figure 1 draws the whole problem: the current design, with the discrete solution at this page's defaults, N=8N=8 and first order (cell averages, drawn at the cell centres). The lower panel is the source: the 8 bars are the current constant values σk=0.5\sigma_k=0.5 and the dashed curve is the target source sin⁡(πx)\sin(\pi x). The upper panel is the solution: the solid curve is the exact solution u=1+xu=\sqrt{1+x}, the dots are the discrete solution this page computes (Section 2 onwards shows how) and the dashed curve is the target field utgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}. The arrows between the panels give the wave speed uu along the interval: all point right and lengthen as uu grows. The inlet x=0x=0 has the prescribed uin=1u_{in}=1; the outlet x=1x=1 takes no condition.

波速：信息从入口流向出口

Wave speed: information travels from the inlet to the outlet

通量对状态的导数 F′(u)=uF'(u)=u 就是波速（特征速度）：uu 的一个小扰动以速度 uu 沿 xx 传播。当前解处处 u≥1>0u\ge1>0，所以信息从左向右传播（图 1中间的箭头）。于是左端 x=0x=0 是入口，要给一个条件 u(0)=uinu(0)=u_{in}；右端 x=1x=1 是出口，不给条件，出口值由方程和上游的数据决定。第 4 节说明离散格式怎样处理这两端。

The derivative of the flux with respect to the state, F′(u)=uF'(u)=u, is the wave speed (the characteristic speed): a small disturbance of uu travels along xx with speed uu. The current solution has u≥1>0u\ge1>0 everywhere, so information travels from left to right (the arrows in the middle of Figure 1). The left end x=0x=0 is therefore the inlet and takes one condition, u(0)=uinu(0)=u_{in}; the right end x=1x=1 is the outlet and takes none, since the equation and the upstream data determine the outlet value. Section 4 shows how the discretisation treats the two ends.

源项、设计变量与精确解

The source, the design variables and the exact solution

源项在 [0,1][0,1] 的 NN 个等长区间上分段取常值 σk\sigma_k（图 1下半部分的柱）；默认 N=8N=8，这些区间也是第 2 节网格的原始区间。NN 个源项值与入口值一起构成设计输入 DD，改变它们就改变流场：

The source is piecewise constant, with the value σk\sigma_k on each of NN equal intervals of [0,1][0,1] (the bars in the lower part of Figure 1); by default N=8N=8, and these intervals are also the primal intervals of the mesh of Section 2. The NN source values and the inlet value form the design input DD; changing them changes the flow:

s(x)=σk,kN<x<k+1N,k=0,…,N−1,D=(σ0,…,σN−1,uin).\begin{aligned}s(x)&=\sigma_k,\qquad \tfrac kN<x<\tfrac{k+1}N,\quad k=0,\ldots,N-1,\\D&=(\sigma_0,\ldots,\sigma_{N-1},u_{in}).\end{aligned}

默认 N=8N=8 时，D=(σ0,…,σ7,uin)D=(\sigma_0,\ldots,\sigma_{7},u_{in}) 共有 9 个分量。当前设计取全部 σk=0.5\sigma_k=0.5、uin=1u_{in}=1，方程成为 u u′=0.5u\,u'=0.5。它可以直接积分：从 00 积分到 xx，通量的改变量等于源项的累积，再代入常数源项：

With the default N=8N=8, D=(σ0,…,σ7,uin)D=(\sigma_0,\ldots,\sigma_{7},u_{in}) has 9 components. The current design takes σk=0.5\sigma_k=0.5 for every kk and uin=1u_{in}=1, so the equation becomes u u′=0.5u\,u'=0.5. It can be integrated directly: from 00 to xx the change of the flux equals the accumulated source, and with the constant source

u(x)22=uin22+∫0xs(t) dt=12+x2⟹u(x)=1+x.\begin{aligned}\frac{u(x)^2}{2}&=\frac{u_{in}^2}{2}+\int_0^x s(t)\,dt\\&=\frac12+\frac x2\qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad u(x)=\sqrt{1+x}.\end{aligned}

取正平方根，因为本页只研究正解分支。出口值 u(1)=2u(1)=\sqrt2 不是给定的，而是由方程和入口数据决定（图 1的实线）。这个闭式解是第 15 节测量网格收敛的参考解，也是第 16 节和附录 A 中连续伴随的出发点。

The positive root is taken because this page studies the positive branch. The outlet value u(1)=2u(1)=\sqrt2 is not prescribed; the equation and the inlet data determine it (the solid curve in Figure 1). This closed form is the reference for the mesh-convergence study of Section 15 and the starting point of the continuous adjoint in Section 16 and Appendix A.

设计的目的在第 7 节给出：调整源项，让解接近目标场 utgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}（图 1上半部分的虚线）。目标场由目标源项 sin⁡(πx)\sin(\pi x) 和同一个入口值产生；目标函数测量解与目标场的差别，这是一个反设计问题。

Section 7 gives the purpose of the design: adjust the source so that the solution approaches the target field utgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}} (the dashed curve in the upper part of Figure 1). The target is produced by the target source sin⁡(πx)\sin(\pi x) with the same inlet value; the objective measures the mismatch between the solution and the target, which makes this an inverse-design problem.

这个方程的作用

What this equation is for

在流体力学里，Burgers 方程保留了动量方程中的非线性对流项 u uxu\,u_x，去掉了压力；它是含有这一项的最简单的方程。没有黏性时，速度大的部分追上前面速度小的部分，波形变陡，最后形成激波（附录 B 讨论激波和它的伴随）。加上黏性项，ut+(u2/2)x=νuxxu_t+(u^2/2)_x=\nu u_{xx}，变陡与扩散互相平衡，形成有限厚度的光滑过渡层（附录 D.3、D.4 用的就是带黏性的形式）。正因为它简单而又保留了非线性，数值通量、迎风格式和斜率限制器常常先在这个方程上检验。

In fluid dynamics the Burgers equation keeps the nonlinear convection term u uxu\,u_x of the momentum equation and drops the pressure; it is the simplest equation that carries this term. Without viscosity, faster parts of a wave catch up with slower parts ahead of them, the profile steepens and a shock forms (Appendix B treats shocks and their adjoints). With a viscous term, ut+(u2/2)x=νuxxu_t+(u^2/2)_x=\nu u_{xx}, steepening and diffusion balance in a smooth transition layer of finite width (Appendices D.3 and D.4 use viscous forms of the equation). Because it is simple yet keeps the nonlinearity, numerical fluxes, upwind schemes and slope limiters are commonly tested on it first.

在本课程里，它作为第一个算例，有五个理由：

In this course it is the first example, for five reasons:

  • 小。默认网格只有 8 个未知量，每个数组和矩阵都能完整地写在页面上，逐句播放也看得清。
  • Small. The default mesh has only 8 unknowns, so every array and matrix fits on the page and the statement players stay readable.
  • 非线性。通量的斜率 F′(u)=uF'(u)=u 随状态改变，所以线性化（Jacobian）取决于在哪个状态上求导：前向与伴随都在收敛的原始解上计算。
  • Nonlinear. The slope of the flux, F′(u)=uF'(u)=u, changes with the state, so the linearisation (the Jacobian) depends on the state it is taken at: the tangent and the adjoint are both evaluated at the converged primal solution.
  • 有精确解可比。闭式解 u=1+xu=\sqrt{1+x} 用来测量离散误差（第 15 节）；连续伴随也能写出来（第 16 节、附录 A），用来和离散伴随对照。
  • Exact answers to compare with. The closed form u=1+xu=\sqrt{1+x} measures the discretisation error (Section 15), and the continuous adjoint can be written down too (Section 16, Appendix A) for comparison with the discrete one.
  • 设计变量在源项里。改变设计不会移动网格，所以不需要对网格坐标求导；几何导数留给二维页面。
  • Design variables in the source. Changing the design does not move the mesh, so no derivatives with respect to mesh coordinates are needed; geometric derivatives are left to the 2-D pages.
  • 同一个面循环。本页的面循环（收集、重构、算通量、分发）在 Euler、N–S 和 RANS 页面上反复出现，只是每个面上的计算更多；黏性页面还要先算一遍梯度。
  • The same face loop. This page’s face loop (gather, reconstruct, evaluate the flux, scatter) reappears on the Euler, N–S and RANS pages, with more work on each face; the viscous pages first compute gradients.

图 2画出通量 F(u)=u2/2F(u)=u^2/2。当前解的状态从入口的 uin=1u_{in}=1 增加到出口的 u(1)=2u(1)=\sqrt2，占据曲线上加粗的一段。两端切线的斜率就是两处的波速：入口处为 11，出口处为 2≈1.414\sqrt2\approx1.414。斜率随状态改变，这就是非线性：在一个状态上求出的导数，不能拿到另一个状态上用。所以第 3 节数值通量的偏导 cL,cRc_L,c_R 和第 6 节的 Jacobian 都要在当前状态上计算，前向与伴随则在收敛的原始解上计算。竖直方向，两端通量之差 F(2)−F(1)=0.5F(\sqrt2)-F(1)=0.5 恰好等于源项的积分 ∫01s dx=0.5\int_0^1s\,dx=0.5：定常时，流出的通量减去流入的通量，等于区间里的源项。第 3 节就从这个守恒关系出发，把它写到每一个控制体上。

Figure 2 plots the flux F(u)=u2/2F(u)=u^2/2. The state of the current solution rises from uin=1u_{in}=1 at the inlet to u(1)=2u(1)=\sqrt2 at the outlet and covers the thick part of the curve. The slopes of the tangents at the two ends are the wave speeds there: 11 at the inlet and 2≈1.414\sqrt2\approx1.414 at the outlet. The slope changes with the state, and that is the nonlinearity: a derivative computed at one state cannot be reused at another. The flux derivatives cL,cRc_L,c_R of Section 3 and the Jacobian of Section 6 are therefore evaluated at the current state, and the tangent and the adjoint at the converged primal solution. Vertically, the difference of the end fluxes, F(2)−F(1)=0.5F(\sqrt2)-F(1)=0.5, equals the integrated source ∫01s dx=0.5\int_0^1s\,dx=0.5: in a steady state the flux out minus the flux in equals the source inside. Section 3 starts from this conservation statement and writes it for every control volume.

图 3把本页放在整个网站的路线上。每往右一步主要增加一类新内容：拟一维 Euler 把一个方程换成质量、动量、能量三个方程，并引入压力和变截面积；二维 Euler 增加第二个空间方向，面有了法向，网格坐标也成为设计变量；二维层流 N–S 加入黏性应力和热传导，面上还要用到梯度；二维 RANS–SA 再加一个湍流模型方程。每点的未知量从 1 个增加到 5 个，但每一页的残差仍由面循环组装，前向与伴随也沿同一个循环求导。另有两页与本页相邻：一维层流 N–S 页留在一维，在 Euler 方程上加入黏性和热传导；二维标量对流页是本页在二维的对应页面。

Figure 3 places this page on the route through the site. Each step to the right mainly adds one kind of ingredient: quasi-1-D Euler replaces the single equation by three (mass, momentum and energy) and brings in the pressure and a varying cross-section; 2-D Euler adds a second space direction, so faces have normals and the mesh coordinates become design variables; 2-D laminar N–S adds viscous stresses and heat conduction, which need gradients at the faces; 2-D RANS–SA adds one turbulence-model equation. The unknowns per point grow from 1 to 5, yet every page still assembles its residual with face loops, and the tangent and the adjoint differentiate the same loops. Two more pages sit next to this one: the 1-D laminar N–S page stays in one dimension and adds viscosity and heat conduction to the Euler equations, and the 2-D scalar advection page is this page's counterpart in two dimensions.

本页要回答的问题

The question this page answers

假设你已经学过微积分、矩阵乘法、Newton 法和线性方程的迭代求解。本页要连接这些知识：先把一个微分方程写成有限个非线性代数方程，再求“输入改变一点，解和目标函数会改变多少”。你不需要先学自动微分或最优化；前向与伴随都从链式法则和矩阵转置开始。

This page assumes calculus, matrix multiplication, Newton’s method and iterative linear solvers. We connect them by turning a differential equation into finitely many nonlinear equations, then asking how a small input change affects the solution and an objective. Automatic differentiation and optimisation are not prerequisites: forward and adjoint calculations start with the chain rule and matrix transposition.

本页只回答一个问题：设计输入 DD 改变一点，目标 JJ 改变多少；页首的全页路线图把后面各节串成一条线。按页首默认设置（一阶、GS 固定点、每次一轮扫描）实际计数，9 次前向求解共用 209 次 GS 扫描，1 次伴随求解只用 24 次。

This page answers one question: how much does the objective JJ change when the design input DD changes a little? The page roadmap at the top strings the later sections together. Counted with the default settings at the top of the page (first order, GS fixed point, one sweep per application), the 9 forward solves take 209 GS sweeps in total and the single adjoint solve only 24.

要在计算机上回答这个问题，先要把连续方程换成有限个未知量的代数方程。第 2 节先建立网格、决定未知量放在哪里；第 3 节再把守恒律写成面上的通量差。

To answer it on a computer, the continuous equation must first become algebraic equations in finitely many unknowns. Section 2 builds the mesh and decides where the unknowns live; Section 3 then writes the conservation law as flux differences across faces.

第 2 节Section 2

网格：未知量放在哪里

The mesh: where the unknowns live

第 1 节的方程对区间上的每一个 xx 都成立，计算机却只能保存有限个数。本节选网格：决定未知量放在哪里、数组怎样编号，再写下本页用到的符号和数据。

The equation of Section 1 holds at every xx of the interval, but a computer stores finitely many numbers. This section chooses the mesh: it decides where the unknowns live and how the arrays are numbered, and fixes the notation and data used on this page.

先把物理问题、网格和数组分开

Separate the physical problem, mesh and arrays

用 NN 表示原始区间数，h=1/Nh=1/N 表示网格宽度，MM 表示未知量个数。数组从 0 开始编号。格心格式有 M=NM=N；格点格式有 M=N+1M=N+1。网格位置 xix_i 是已知几何数据，未知量 uiu_i 是要解出的数值，二者不能混淆。

Let NN be the number of primal intervals, h=1/Nh=1/N the spacing and MM the number of unknowns. Arrays use zero-based indices. Cells have M=NM=N unknowns; nodes have M=N+1M=N+1. Coordinates xix_i are known geometric data; values uiu_i are numbers to solve for.

格心格式把每个区间本身作为控制体，未知量是区间平均值，画在中心只是表示它的存储位置。一个单元有左、右两个边界面；在一维，“面”是一个点。积分方程仍需要该点的通量，不能因为面没有长度就把它省去。

For a cell scheme, each interval is a control volume. Its unknown is an interval average; the centre marks where it is stored. Each cell has a left and a right face. In one dimension a face is a point, but the integrated equation still needs the flux at that point.

本页的符号和数据

Notation and data used on this page

u∈ℝMu\in\mathbb R^M 是状态向量，D=(σ0,…,σN−1,uin)D=(\sigma_0,\ldots,\sigma_{N-1},u_{in}) 是设计输入，R(u,D)∈ℝMR(u,D)\in\mathbb R^M 是残差，J(u)J(u) 是一个标量目标。按伴随优化文献的通常写法，设计变量记作 DD。求导采用自动微分（AD）的记号：程序中任一变量 xx 的前向（tangent）导数记作 x˙\dot x，反向（adjoint）累加到 xx 上的权重记作 xˉ\bar x。设计方向是种子 D˙\dot D；v≡u˙v\equiv\dot u 是状态的切向量，也就是前向求解得到的数组；ww 是检验转置乘积时任意给定的残差种子 Rˉ=w\bar R=w，ψ\psi 是由伴随方程求出的特定种子。ww 和 ψ\psi 的用途不同。

The state is u∈ℝMu\in\mathbb R^M, the design input is D=(σ0,…,σN−1,uin)D=(\sigma_0,\ldots,\sigma_{N-1},u_{in}), the residual is R(u,D)∈ℝMR(u,D)\in\mathbb R^M, and the objective J(u)J(u) is a scalar. As is usual in the adjoint-optimization literature, the design variables are written DD. Derivatives use the notation of automatic differentiation (AD): the forward (tangent) derivative of any program variable xx is x˙\dot x, and the weight accumulated into xx in reverse (adjoint) mode is xˉ\bar x. A design direction is the seed D˙\dot D; v≡u˙v\equiv\dot u is the state tangent, the array returned by a tangent solve; ww is an arbitrary residual seed Rˉ=w\bar R=w for testing a transpose product, and ψ\psi is the particular seed obtained by solving the adjoint equation. These two seeds serve different purposes.

当前计算网格

The current computational mesh

未知量是 NN 个单元上的平均值 uiu_i，中心坐标 xi=(i+1/2)hx_i=(i+1/2)h。单元宽度和目标函数权重均为 h=1/Nh=1/N。二阶重构保持每个单元的平均值。

Unknowns are cell averages uiu_i in NN cells, with centres xi=(i+1/2)hx_i=(i+1/2)h. Cell widths and objective weights are h=1/Nh=1/N. Linear reconstruction preserves each cell average.

页首的一阶／二阶按钮控制整页计算。求解器选择独立于空间精度。所有实时示例使用当前网格、边界处理与设计变量；精度研究使用固定的网格序列，并同时画出两个阶数。

The first-/second-order buttons control calculations throughout this page. Solver choice is independent of spatial order. Live examples share the selected mesh, boundary treatment and design; the accuracy study uses a fixed mesh sequence and displays both orders.

网格与面：计算前准备的数据

Mesh and faces: data prepared before calculation

h = 1 / N; M = N
x[i] = (i+1/2)*h; W[i] = h           # i = 0,...,N-1
faces = [(-1, 0, 0)]                  # prescribed exterior inlet
faces += [(i, i+1, (i+1)*h) for i = 0,...,N-2]
faces += [(N-1, -1, 1)]               # physical outflow

伪代码约定：一个面记为 (L,R,xf)(L,R,x_f)；−1-1 表示域外，不是合法数组下标。只有存在对应控制体时才向它累加。WiW_i 是控制体宽度；后面的目标积分也使用它。

Pseudocode convention: a face stores (L,R,xf)(L,R,x_f). The index −1-1 means exterior, not a valid array index. Accumulate only when the corresponding volume exists. The width WiW_i also supplies the objective quadrature weight.

网格定下了控制体和它们的面。第 3 节把第 1 节的守恒律写到控制体上：控制体里源项的总量，等于从它两端的面流出的净通量；所以先要会算一个面上的通量。

The mesh fixes the control volumes and their faces. Section 3 writes the conservation law of Section 1 on the control volumes: the total source in a volume equals the net flux out through the faces at its two ends, so the first task is the flux on one face.

第 3 节Section 3

面上的通量：守恒与重构

The flux on a face: conservation and reconstruction

本节实验：改变一个未知量，哪些面值会变化？先预测重构邻域，再用图验证。

Experiment: Which traces change when one unknown changes? Predict the stencil, then inspect the diagram.

第 2 节把区间分成了控制体。本节把守恒律写成控制体上的通量差，用数值通量把面两侧的状态变成一个面通量，再说明二阶格式怎样把状态重构到面上。

Section 2 divided the interval into control volumes. This section writes the conservation law as a flux difference over a control volume, turns the states on the two sides of a face into one face flux with a numerical flux, and then shows how the second-order scheme reconstructs states at the faces.

从守恒到通量差

From conservation to a flux difference

物理通量就是第 1 节的 F(u)=u2/2F(u)=u^2/2。对控制体 [a,b][a,b] 积分，用微积分基本定理，导数积分变为两个端点的通量差。这一步是有限体积法的起点：控制体内的源项总量，必须等于净流出通量。

The physical flux is the F(u)=u2/2F(u)=u^2/2 of Section 1. Integrate over a volume [a,b][a,b] and use the fundamental theorem of calculus: the derivative becomes the difference of endpoint fluxes. This is the starting point of finite volumes: the integrated source equals the net outward flux.

∫abdFdx dx=F(u(b))−F(u(a))=∫abs(x) dx.\int_a^b \frac{dF}{dx}\,dx=F(u(b))-F(u(a))=\int_a^b s(x)\,dx.

离散后，相邻控制体可能给同一个面提供不同的近似值 a,ba,b，所以需要一个数值通量 H(a,b)H(a,b) 把这两个值变成一个面通量。这里的 a,ba,b 是状态，不是上一式的积分端点。通量应满足一致性 H(u,u)=F(u)H(u,u)=F(u)。共享同一个 HH，还让内部面的贡献在全域求和时严格相消。

After discretisation, neighbouring volumes can supply different states a,ba,b at the same face. A numerical flux H(a,b)H(a,b) turns these into one shared flux. Here a,ba,b denote states rather than integration endpoints. Consistency requires H(u,u)=F(u)H(u,u)=F(u). Sharing the same flux also makes interior contributions cancel in a global sum.

本例固定耗散系数为 ε=0.8\varepsilon=0.8。项 −ε(b−a)-\varepsilon(b-a) 抑制相邻状态的跳跃；它也会影响离散误差。第 1 节的精确解 u=1+xu=\sqrt{1+x} 就是后面测量这种误差的参考解。

The dissipation coefficient is fixed at ε=0.8\varepsilon=0.8. The term −ε(b−a)-\varepsilon(b-a) damps state jumps and affects discretisation error. The exact solution u=1+xu=\sqrt{1+x} of Section 1 is the reference against which that error is measured later.

从一阶常值到二阶重构

From constant states to linear reconstruction

一阶格式在控制体内取常值。二阶内部斜率用中心差分，端点斜率用单边差分。虽然端点斜率本身只有一阶精度，但乘以 O(h)O(h) 的外推距离后，面值仍有 O(h2)O(h^2) 精度；实际全域阶数由网格加密验证。

First order uses piecewise constant values. Second order uses centred interior slopes and one-sided endpoint slopes. The endpoint slope is only first-order accurate, but multiplication by an O(h)O(h) extrapolation distance gives an O(h2)O(h^2) face value; mesh refinement checks the resulting global order.

di=ui+1−ui−12h,d0=u1−u0h,dM−1=uM−1−uM−2h,ui(x)=ui+(x−xi)di.d_i=\frac{u_{i+1}-u_{i-1}}{2h},\quad d_0=\frac{u_1-u_0}{h},\quad d_{M-1}=\frac{u_{M-1}-u_{M-2}}{h},\qquad u_i(x)=u_i+(x-x_i)d_i.
ufL=ui+h2di,ufR=ui+1−h2di+1,H(a,b)=a2+b24−ε(b−a),ε=0.8.u_f^L=u_i+\frac h2d_i,\quad u_f^R=u_{i+1}-\frac h2d_{i+1},\qquad H(a,b)=\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}-\varepsilon(b-a),\quad\varepsilon=0.8.

其中 MM 是未知量个数。通量的两个偏导为 cL=a/2+εc_L=a/2+\varepsilon、cR=b/2−εc_R=b/2-\varepsilon。重构之后仍使用同一个通量；二阶精度来自面值重构。下图可选择一个面，查看两侧斜率与重构值。

Here MM is the number of unknowns. Flux derivatives are cL=a/2+εc_L=a/2+\varepsilon and cR=b/2−εc_R=b/2-\varepsilon. Both orders use the same numerical flux: reconstruction changes the face values. Select a face below to inspect the slopes and reconstructed states.

把重构写成可以求导的加权和

Write reconstruction as differentiable weighted sums

二阶不是更换 Burgers 通量，而是用相邻数据估计面上的状态。以内部左迹为例，把中心斜率代入 qL=ui+(h/2)diq_L=u_i+(h/2)d_i，就得到三个非零权重。右迹同理；合起来一个面依赖四个未知量。这也解释了为什么二阶 Jacobian 比一阶更宽。

Second order estimates face states using neighbouring data while retaining the Burgers flux. Substitute the centred slope into qL=ui+(h/2)diq_L=u_i+(h/2)d_i to obtain three nonzero weights. The right trace works similarly; together a face depends on four unknowns. This explains the wider second-order Jacobian.

qL=ui+h2ui+1−ui−12h=−14ui−1+ui+14ui+1,qR=14ui+ui+1−14ui+2.q_L=u_i+\frac h2\frac{u_{i+1}-u_{i-1}}{2h}=-\tfrac14u_{i-1}+u_i+\tfrac14u_{i+1},\qquad q_R=\tfrac14u_i+u_{i+1}-\tfrac14u_{i+2}.

重构伪代码：一阶与二阶共用入口

Reconstruction pseudocode: one interface for both orders

trace(i, xf, u, order):
    if order == 1: return u[i]
    if i == 0: slope = (u[1] - u[0]) / h
    else if i == M-1: slope = (u[M-1] - u[M-2]) / h
    else: slope = (u[i+1] - u[i-1]) / (2*h)
    return u[i] + (xf - x[i]) * slope

读图练习：先选一阶，再选二阶，保持面编号不变。观察左右迹、模板点与通量怎样变化。线性函数应被二阶重构精确再现；这说明局部重构正确，但全局二阶还需要边界、源项积分和网格加密结果共同支持。

Try keeping the same face selected while switching order. Observe the traces, stencil points and flux. Second-order reconstruction reproduces a linear function exactly. This checks local reconstruction; global second order also depends on boundaries, source integration and mesh refinement.

到这里，每个内部面的通量都能由两侧的重构状态算出。区间两端的面不同：入口面 x=0x=0 左侧没有控制体，只有给定的 uinu_{in}；出口面 x=1x=1 右侧什么也没有。第 4 节写出这两个边界面上的通量。

Every interior face now gets its flux from the reconstructed states on its two sides. The two end faces differ: the inlet face x=0x=0 has no control volume on its left, only the prescribed uinu_{in}, and nothing lies to the right of the outlet face x=1x=1. Section 4 writes the fluxes on these two boundary faces.

第 4 节Section 4

边界条件：入口与出口

Boundary conditions: inlet and outlet

为什么只给一个入口条件

Why prescribe only one inlet condition?

第 1 节从波速的方向说明了只给入口条件的原因。换一个角度看，定常方程在正解分支上是一阶常微分方程。给定 u(0)u(0) 后，积分就确定沿程的 u(x)u(x)；出口值应由内部解决定。再任意指定一个出口值，通常会过约束。离散时仍须提供出口通量，但“计算出口通量”与“另加出口值约束”是两件事。

Section 1 explained the single inlet condition by the direction of the wave speed. Seen another way, the steady equation on the positive branch is first order. Once u(0)u(0) is specified, integration determines u(x)u(x) downstream. An arbitrary additional outlet value would generally overconstrain it. The discretisation still needs an outlet flux, but evaluating that flux is different from imposing an extra outlet-value constraint.

入口通量使用外部给定值 uinu_{in} 与从第一个单元重构至 x=0x=0 的内部迹。出口从末单元重构到 x=1x=1，再计算物理通量。二阶出口若仍直接使用末单元平均值，就会引入一阶边界误差。

The inlet flux uses the prescribed exterior value uinu_{in} and the interior trace reconstructed to x=0x=0. At the outlet, reconstruct from the final cell to x=1x=1 before applying the physical flux. Using the final cell average directly at a second-order outlet would introduce a first-order boundary error.

uinR=u0−h2d0,Hin=H(uin,uinR),uout=uN−1+h2dN−1,Hout=12uout2.u_{in}^{R}=u_0-\frac h2d_0,\quad H_{in}=H(u_{in},u_{in}^{R}),\qquad u_{out}=u_{N-1}+\frac h2d_{N-1},\quad H_{out}=\frac12u_{out}^2.

图 7用本页默认网格（N=8N=8，一阶）的编号和收敛值画出两个边界面。入口面 f0f_0 左边没有控制体：外部值 uinu_{in} 是设计输入，不是未知量，所以它的偏导不进入 AA，只进入 RDR_D；面右边的内部迹 qRq_R 才依赖未知量。出口面只有左边的单元，直接用物理通量 uout2/2u_{out}^2/2，不需要任何外部值；二阶时 uoutu_{out} 由最后两个单元外推。

Figure 7 draws the two boundary faces with the indices and converged values of the default mesh (N=8N=8, first order). The inlet face f0f_0 has no control volume on its left: the exterior value uinu_{in} is a design input, not an unknown, so its partial derivative enters RDR_D and not AA; only the interior trace qRq_R on the right depends on unknowns. The outlet face has a cell on its left only and uses the physical flux uout2/2u_{out}^2/2 with no exterior value; at second order uoutu_{out} is extrapolated from the last two cells.

“边界对照”允许改用迎风通量 H=a2/2H=a^2/2：格心改入口面，格点改第一内部对偶面。它是另一种明确标记的离散边界闭合，用于第 16 节比较。格点二阶迎风面依赖重构斜率，因此它仍依赖相邻未知量。

The boundary comparison replaces one flux by H=a2/2H=a^2/2: the inlet face for cells, or the first internal dual face for nodes. This is a distinct, explicitly labelled boundary closure studied in Section 16. At second order, the node-based upwind face depends on its slope and therefore still on neighbouring unknowns.

对状态求导时，给定的入口值暂时固定，外部入口的切向量 u˙in=0\dot u_{in}=0；对入口设计变量求导时，它是种子 u˙in\dot u_{in} 不为零的输入。这两个导数分别进入 A=RuA=R_u 和 RDR_D，不能混在一个状态模板里。边界对照改变的是离散方程本身，因此必须同时改变原始、前向、伴随和目标场。

When differentiating with respect to the state, hold the prescribed inlet fixed: its exterior tangent is u˙in=0\dot u_{in}=0. When differentiating with respect to the inlet design variable, it is an input with a nonzero seed u˙in\dot u_{in}. These paths enter A=RuA=R_u and RDR_D separately. Changing the boundary comparison changes the discretisation and must be reflected in the primal, forward, adjoint and target field.

第 5 节Section 5

残差：收集、重构、计算、分发

Residual: gather, reconstruct, compute, scatter

先固定离散问题与符号

Fix the discrete problem and its notation

本页每个单元存储 1 个未知量。以下用 𝐮\mathbf u 表示把所有位置按代码顺序排成的列向量（标量问题每个位置只有一个分量）。它是一个有限维向量，不是连续函数。物理方程中的空间导数只用于说明模型；求离散伴随时，求导对象是本页实际装配的有限维函数。

Each cell stores 1 unknown. Below, 𝐮\mathbf u stacks all locations in code order (a scalar problem has one component per location). It is a finite-dimensional vector, not a continuous function. Spatial derivatives in the physical equations explain the model; discrete differentiation acts on the actual finite-dimensional functions assembled on this page.

𝐮∈ℝnu,D∈ℝna,R:ℝnu×ℝna→ℝnu,J:ℝnu×ℝna→ℝ.\mathbf u\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad D\in\mathbb R^{n_a},\quad R:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad J:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R.

DD 是本页全部设计变量排成的向量：每个原始区间上的常源项 σk\sigma_k 与入口值 uinu_{in}。第 6 节按空间阶数把精确 Jacobian 记作 AqA_q，这里的 AA 就是当前阶数的 AqA_q；第 7 节的 gg 就是这里的状态梯度；第 10 节的 f=RD D˙f=R_D\,\dot D 是 RDR_D 作用在设计种子 D˙\dot D 上的结果。

DD stacks all design variables of this page: the constant source σk\sigma_k on each original interval and the inlet value uinu_{in}. Section 6 writes the exact Jacobian of each spatial order as AqA_q; the AA here is the AqA_q of the current order. The gg of Section 7 is the state gradient here, and the f=RD D˙f=R_D\,\dot D of Section 10 is RDR_D applied to the design seed D˙\dot D.

A=∂R∂𝐮∈ℝnu×nu,RD=∂R∂D∈ℝnu×na,g=(∂J∂𝐮)T∈ℝnu,∇DJ=(∂J∂D)T∈ℝna.A=\frac{\partial R}{\partial \mathbf u}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_u},\quad R_D=\frac{\partial R}{\partial D}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_a},\quad g=\Big(\frac{\partial J}{\partial \mathbf u}\Big)^{T}\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad \nabla_DJ=\Big(\frac{\partial J}{\partial D}\Big)^{T}\in\mathbb R^{n_a}.

这里 gg、∇DJ\nabla_DJ 都是列向量，它们的转置才是偏导数行。求导采用自动微分（AD）的记号：程序变量 xx 上加点的 x˙\dot x 是前向（tangent）模式沿给定种子方向的导数，加横线的 xˉ\bar x 是反向（adjoint）模式累加到 xx 上的权重，例如 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} 与 𝐮ˉ\bar{\mathbf u}。两者都是对本页有限维代码求导；变分符号 δ\delta 只用于连续伴随附录里连续函数的变分。

Both gg and ∇DJ\nabla_DJ are columns; their transposes are the derivative rows. Derivatives use the notation of automatic differentiation (AD): a dot x˙\dot x on a program variable xx is its forward (tangent) derivative along the chosen seed direction, and a bar xˉ\bar x is the weight accumulated into xx in reverse (adjoint) mode, for example 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} and 𝐮ˉ\bar{\mathbf u}. Both differentiate the finite-dimensional code of this page; the variation symbol δ\delta is kept for variations of continuous functions in the continuous-adjoint appendix.

残差是“还没有平衡的量”

A residual measures the remaining imbalance

把所有离散平衡式的右侧移到左侧，得到向量 R(u,D)R(u,D)。一个分量对应一个方程；Ri=0R_i=0 表示该控制体平衡。求解器的任务是找使全部分量同时为零的 uu。计算残差本身只是在给定 uu 后做一次函数求值，不会自动求出解。

Move each discrete balance to the left to form R(u,D)R(u,D). One component represents one equation; Ri=0R_i=0 means balance in that volume. The solver seeks a state making all components zero simultaneously. Evaluating the residual at a supplied state is only a function evaluation, not a solution of the equations.

面循环比逐行重复计算通量更直接：先把残差数组清零，再遍历每个面，重构状态、计算通量、向两侧累加，最后扣除源项。内部通量在两个方程中重复出现，却只计算一次。这里存储的是积分残差，没有除以控制体宽度 WiW_i；后面的 Jacobian、目标权重和伴随符号都按这一约定。

A face loop evaluates each shared flux once: zero the residual, visit each face, reconstruct states, compute the flux, add it to its neighbours, then subtract sources. An interior flux appears in two equations but is evaluated once. We store integrated residuals without dividing by volume width WiW_i; all Jacobians, objective weights and adjoint conventions follow this choice.

三个矩阵符号分别做什么

What the three matrix symbols do

TL,TRT_L,T_R 的一行存储一个面的重构权重；一阶每行通常只有一个 1，二阶每行通常有三个非零数。已知的入口常数另存为 bLb_L。ℬ\mathcal B 的一列对应一个面，在左行放 +1+1、右行放 −1-1。所以矩阵写法只是把刚才的收集与分发打包，并没有增加新的数值方法。

TL,TRT_L,T_R store one face’s reconstruction weights per row: typically one unit entry at first order and three nonzero entries at second order. Prescribed inlet constants are stored separately in bLb_L. A column of ℬ\mathcal B represents one face, with +1+1 in the left row and −1-1 in the right. The matrix notation packages gather and scatter; it introduces no new numerical method.

qL=TLu+bL,q˙L=TLv(D˙=0),R˙=ℬ H˙.q_L=T_Lu+b_L,\qquad \dot q_L=T_Lv\quad(\dot D=0),\qquad \dot R=\mathcal B\,\dot H.

这些矩阵式首先描述未经入口行替换的通量部分。出口只用左迹的物理通量；格点的第 0 行最后单独施加约束。播放器中的权重列表就是这些稀疏矩阵的非零项。

These matrix expressions first describe the flux contribution before inlet row replacement. The outlet uses the physical flux of its left trace, and the node scheme applies its row-0 constraint separately. The player’s weight lists are the nonzero entries of these sparse maps.

设计变量为每个原始区间上的常源项 σk\sigma_k 和入口值。源项先积分到控制体，面通量按左正右负分发。符号约定固定为“流出减流入减源项”。

Design variables are the constant source values σk\sigma_k on the primal intervals and the inlet value. Integrate sources over control volumes, then scatter each face flux with a positive sign to its left and a negative sign to its right. The residual convention is outflow minus inflow minus source.

Si=hσi,Ri=Hi+1/2−Hi−1/2−Si.S_i=h\sigma_i,\qquad R_i=H_{i+1/2}-H_{i-1/2}-S_i.

格点源项公式中不存在的区间项取零。将重构写为线性映射 TL,TRT_L,T_R，将面到控制体的有向分发写为 ℬ\mathcal B，可以把两个空间阶数统一为下面的计算链。边界常数和入口行替换需要额外处理。

Missing interval terms in the node-based source formula are zero. Linear reconstruction maps TL,TRT_L,T_R and the oriented face-to-volume scatter ℬ\mathcal B unify both spatial orders. Boundary constants and the inlet row replacement are handled separately.

u →TL,TR (qL,qR) →H Hf →ℬ R=ℬH−S.u\ \xrightarrow{T_L,T_R}\ (q_L,q_R)\ \xrightarrow{H}\ H_f\ \xrightarrow{\mathcal B}\ R=\mathcal B H-S.

怎样使用逐句播放器：高亮行是刚执行的语句，变量表只显示已经算出的量，下层网格是执行后的累积数组。“下一步”前进一句；同一面内先得到左右迹，再算通量，最后分别更新左右残差。源项和入口约束也有独立步骤。符号 −1-1 只表示域外，访问数组之前会被排除。

Reading the statement player: the highlighted line has just executed, the variable table contains values already computed, and the lower mesh shows the accumulated array afterwards. Next advances one statement: left trace, right trace, flux, left update, right update. Sources and the inlet constraint have separate steps. Exterior index −1-1 is excluded before array access.

第 6 节Section 6

Jacobian 与 Gauss–Seidel 迭代

The Jacobian and Gauss–Seidel iteration

从 Newton 法得到线性修正方程

From Newton’s method to a linear correction

你熟悉的一元 Newton 法用切线逼近函数。对向量残差也是同样的思路：在当前状态附近作一阶 Taylor 展开，让线性近似的残差为零。矩阵 AijA_{ij} 表示第 jj 个未知量增加一点，会让第 ii 个残差改变多少。修正量记作 Δu\Delta u：它是求解器每一步的有限增量，不是求导记号。

Scalar Newton uses a tangent line to approximate a function. For a residual vector, use a first-order Taylor expansion at the current state and set the linear approximation to zero. The entry AijA_{ij} measures how residual ii responds to a small change in unknown jj. The correction is written Δu\Delta u: a finite solver increment, not a derivative symbol.

Rq(u+Δu)=Rq(u)+Aq(u)Δu+O(∥Δu∥2),Aq(u)Δu=−Rq(u).R_q(u+\Delta u)=R_q(u)+A_q(u)\Delta u+O(\|\Delta u\|^2),\qquad A_q(u)\Delta u=-R_q(u).

精确 Newton 会使用 AqA_q 并充分求解这个线性方程。本页为了展示实际求解器中常用的低阶近似，改用 P=A1(u)P=A_1(u)，再用有限次 GS 近似解修正方程。每次更新后仍重新计算完整的 RqR_q。因此必须分清三层：空间格式决定 RqR_q；线性化决定 AqA_q；近似矩阵和 GS 决定修正怎样得到。

Exact Newton uses AqA_q and solves that linear system accurately. To illustrate a common low-order approximation, this page uses P=A1(u)P=A_1(u) and a finite number of GS sweeps. Every update is checked with the full residual RqR_q. Distinguish three levels: spatial discretisation defines RqR_q, differentiation defines AqA_q, and the approximate matrix plus GS determines the correction.

GS 中“立即使用新值”是什么意思

What does GS mean by using new values immediately?

[4−1−13][x0x1]=[12],x(0)=(0,0)T.\begin{bmatrix}4&-1\\-1&3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x_0\\x_1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1\\2\end{bmatrix},\qquad x^{(0)}=(0,0)^T.

第一轮先算 x0=(1+x1old)/4=1/4x_0=(1+x_1^{old})/4=1/4，随后立即用这个新值算 x1=(2+x0new)/3=3/4x_1=(2+x_0^{new})/3=3/4。第二轮得到 x0=7/16x_0=7/16、x1=13/16x_1=13/16，逐步接近精确解 (5/11,9/11)(5/11,9/11)。如果第二行仍用旧的 x0=0x_0=0，就不是这次 GS 扫描。下方网格用绿色标出已经更新的位置。

The first sweep computes x0=(1+x1old)/4=1/4x_0=(1+x_1^{old})/4=1/4, then immediately uses it in x1=(2+x0new)/3=3/4x_1=(2+x_0^{new})/3=3/4. The next sweep gives x0=7/16x_0=7/16 and x1=13/16x_1=13/16, approaching (5/11,9/11)(5/11,9/11). Using the old x0=0x_0=0 in the second row would not be this GS sweep. The mesh below marks updated positions in green.

一个内部残差行怎样组成 Jacobian

How one interior residual row forms the Jacobian

先取一阶内部行。它包含右面的 +H+H 和左面的 −H-H；分别求导并保持符号，就得到三对角的三个系数。二阶时每个面还依赖远邻，通过重构权重再乘一次，就扩展到五对角。

For a first-order interior row, differentiate the right-face +H+H and the left-face −H-H with their signs intact. This gives the three tridiagonal coefficients. At second order each face also depends on farther neighbours; multiplication by reconstruction weights widens the row to five diagonals.

Ai,i−1=−cLi−1/2,Ai,i=cLi+1/2−cRi−1/2,Ai,i+1=cRi+1/2.A_{i,i-1}=-c_L^{i-1/2},\quad A_{i,i}=c_L^{i+1/2}-c_R^{i-1/2},\quad A_{i,i+1}=c_R^{i+1/2}.

这个公式只针对两个相邻面都用内部数值通量的平衡行。入口、出口和约束行必须由各自实际表达式求导，不能直接照抄内部公式。

This formula applies to a balance row whose two faces both use the interior numerical flux. Inlet, outlet and constraint rows must be differentiated from their actual expressions.

精确 Jacobian 是当前空间格式的残差导数 Aq=∂Rq/∂uA_q=\partial R_q/\partial u。一阶内部通常是三对角，二阶重构扩大为五对角；边界单边模板也必须求导。求解时只用在当前状态上计算的一阶 Jacobian P=A1(u)P=A_1(u) 构造修正步骤。

The exact Jacobian is Aq=∂Rq/∂uA_q=\partial R_q/\partial u for the selected spatial order. Interior first-order rows are generally tridiagonal; reconstruction widens second-order rows to five diagonals. One-sided boundary stencils must also be differentiated. The correction uses the first-order Jacobian P=A1(u)P=A_1(u) evaluated at the current state.

PkΔu=−Rq(uk),uk+1=uk+ω Δu,Pk=A1(uk),q∈{1,2}.P_k\Delta u=-R_q(u^k),\qquad u^{k+1}=u^k+\omega\,\Delta u,\qquad P_k=A_1(u^k),\quad q\in\{1,2\}.

一轮 GS 扫描怎样更新未知量

How one GS sweep updates the unknowns

把 P=diag⁡(P)+L+UP=\operatorname{diag}(P)+L+U 分为对角、严格下三角和严格上三角部分。内层从零修正开始做固定次数 GS 扫描；一轮扫描中，已经经过的行使用新值。默认一次扫描，属于不精确的线性求解；因此需要继续外层残差矫正。

Split P=diag⁡(P)+L+UP=\operatorname{diag}(P)+L+U into diagonal, strictly lower and strictly upper parts. The inner solve starts from zero correction and performs a fixed number of GS sweeps. Already visited rows use new values. The default single sweep is an inexact linear solve, so outer residual corrections continue.

(diag⁡(P)+L)Δu(ℓ+1)=−Rq−UΔu(ℓ),Δui(ℓ+1)=−Rq,i−∑j<iPijΔuj(ℓ+1)−∑j>iPijΔuj(ℓ)Pii.(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)\Delta u^{(\ell+1)}=-R_q-U\Delta u^{(\ell)},\qquad \Delta u_i^{(\ell+1)}=\frac{-R_{q,i}-\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}\Delta u_j^{(\ell+1)}-\sum_{j>i}P_{ij}\Delta u_j^{(\ell)}}{P_{ii}}.

求解用的矩阵与要求解的方程。一阶 Jacobian 给出修正方向，完整残差 RqR_q 决定何时收敛。二阶求解因此仍保留全部重构项。若修正使状态不再为正，就减小步长以留在当前解支。

The correction matrix and the equation being solved. The first-order Jacobian supplies a correction; the full residual RqR_q determines convergence. A second-order solve therefore retains every reconstruction term. Updates are damped when needed to stay on the positive solution branch.

下面先看两个矩阵的非零结构，再逐行播放一次 GS 扫描，最后观察解和残差怎样随迭代变化。

Below, compare the two matrix stencils, play one GS sweep row by row, then watch the solution and residual change over the iterations.

原始求解：外层更新与内层 GS

Primal solve: outer updates and inner GS

u = positive_initial_state()
repeat:
    r = residual(u, D, selected_order)
    if norm(r) <= tolerance: return u
    P = first_order_jacobian(u)
    delta = zeros(M)
    repeat fixed_number_of_sweeps:
        for i = 0,...,M-1:
            delta[i] = (-r[i] - Σ(j≠i) P[i,j]*delta[j]) / P[i,i]
    alpha = relaxation
    while min(u + alpha*delta) <= 0.05 and alpha > 1e-8: alpha = alpha/2
    u = u + alpha*delta
# At the iteration limit, report non-convergence.

数组 delta 存放修正量 Δu\Delta u。GS 行更新中的同一个数组同时保存“前面行的新值”和“后面行的旧值”。本页每次外层修正把 delta 重新置零；同一次修正内的第二轮 GS 则保留第一轮结果。默认一轮 GS 不等于精确求逆。

The array delta holds the correction Δu\Delta u. Within a GS row update, one array holds new values for visited rows and old values for unvisited rows. Each outer correction starts delta at zero; a second inner sweep retains the first sweep’s result. The default single sweep is not an exact inverse.

下面的动画把原始 GS 缺陷校正画成曲线。先逐行播放第一次修正：正向 GS 扫描从第 0 行走到最后一行，已经更新的一段先离开初值；之后每帧是一次外层迭代。虚线是收敛解 u∗u^*，右边是残差 ∥R(uk)∥2\|R(u^k)\|_2 的历史，下方的柱是各控制体的误差（对数刻度）。右图竖虚线是页面求解器按停止准则结束的位置；动画继续迭代，残差停在舍入平台上，说明迭代确实收敛到了机器精度。比较入口和出口两侧的柱哪边先变短：原始信息沿特征速度 u>0u>0 从入口流向出口。

The animation below draws the primal GS defect correction as a curve. The first correction is played row by row: the forward GS sweep runs from row 0 to the last row, and the updated part leaves the initial value first. After that, each frame is one outer iteration. The dashed curve is the converged solution u∗u^*, the right panel is the history of ∥R(uk)∥2\|R(u^k)\|_2, and the bars below show the error in each control volume on a log scale. The vertical dashed line on the right marks where the page's solver stops by its criterion; the animation keeps iterating until the residual rests on its round-off floor, which shows that the iteration has converged to machine precision. Compare which side of the bars shrinks first: primal information travels with the characteristic speed u>0u>0 from the inlet to the outlet.

符号提示：Euler 的 A(x) 表示截面积；线性系统中的 A 或 AhA_h 表示残差 Jacobian。P 是低阶近似矩阵，B 是从零开始固定次数 GS 扫描形成的预处理映射，通常不等于精确 P⁻¹。

Notation: Euler A(x) denotes area; A or AhA_h in a linear system denotes the residual Jacobian. P is the low-order matrix; B is the fixed number of zero-start GS sweeps, generally not the exact inverse of P.

第 7 节Section 7

目标函数：希望解变成什么样

The objective: the field we want to match

把整条曲线的差异变成一个数

Turn a field mismatch into one number

如果要调整源项，让当前解接近给定目标场，就需要一个衡量差异的标量。平方差不受误差正负抵消影响，控制体宽度 WiW_i 使求和近似空间积分。前面的 1/21/2 只为了求导时消去平方带来的系数 2。

To adjust sources toward a target field, measure the mismatch by a scalar. Squaring prevents positive and negative errors from cancelling; volume weights WiW_i make the sum approximate an integral. The factor 1/21/2 cancels the factor 2 when differentiating the square.

J˙=12∑iWi 2(ui−uitgt)u˙i=∑igivi=gTv.\dot J=\frac12\sum_iW_i\,2(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_i)\dot u_i=\sum_i g_i v_i=g^Tv.

这里 g=Jug=J_u 只描述目标函数对状态的直接敏感度，还不是对源项的梯度；目标场 utgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}} 冻结，没有切向量。源项改变后，所有状态会通过平衡方程联动；我们还需要计算 v=u˙v=\dot u，或用伴随把这层依赖消掉。

The vector g=Jug=J_u describes direct sensitivity to the state, not yet to the sources; the target field utgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}} is frozen and has no tangent. A source change affects the state through the balance equations. We must either compute v=u˙v=\dot u or use an adjoint to eliminate that dependence.

目标是让解接近目标源项 sin⁡(πx)\sin(\pi x) 产生的流场。每种离散格式先求出自己的目标场 uqtgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}_q，然后在设计求导时保持它不变。切换阶数或边界格式会重建目标场；当前设计改变时它不重新求解。

The inverse objective matches the field generated by sin⁡(πx)\sin(\pi x). Each discretisation first computes its own target field uqtgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}_q, which is then frozen during design differentiation. Changing spatial order or boundary closure rebuilds this target; changing the current design does not.

Jq(u)=12∑iWi(ui−uq,itgt)2,gi=∂Jq∂ui=Wi(ui−uq,itgt).J_q(u)=\frac12\sum_i W_i(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})^2,\qquad g_i=\frac{\partial J_q}{\partial u_i}=W_i(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i}).

因此，在目标设计处，离散 JqJ_q 和梯度同时为零。第 15 节的精度比较另用统一连续参考，防止把各网格自己的目标当作误差基准。

Thus the discrete objective and gradient vanish at the target design. Section 15 uses a shared continuous reference for its accuracy comparisons, rather than treating each grid’s discrete target as its own error reference.

目标函数与状态梯度

Objective and state gradient

target = solve_primal(target_source, prescribed_inlet)  # compute once
J = 0
for i = 0,...,M-1:
    mismatch = u[i] - target[i]
    J += 0.5 * W[i] * mismatch*mismatch
    g[i] = W[i] * mismatch
# Reuse this frozen target for every design change.

从离散目标得到伴随右端

From a discrete objective to the adjoint right-hand side

不能只对连续积分写一个形式导数就结束。先确定代码实际使用的求积点、权重、重构状态及边界值，再对这个标量表达式求导。一般的求积和及其链式法则是：

A formal derivative of a continuous integral is not enough. First identify the quadrature points, weights, reconstructed states and boundary values actually used by the code, then differentiate that scalar expression. A general quadrature sum and its chain rule are:

J=∑qωq(D) θq(𝐮,D),J˙=∑q[ωq θ˙q+θq ω˙q].J=\sum_q\omega_q(D)\,\theta_q(\mathbf u,D),\qquad \dot J=\sum_q\left[\omega_q\,\dot\theta_q+\theta_q\,\dot\omega_q\right].

平方跟踪目标是它的特例：θq=12eq2\theta_q=\tfrac12e_q^2，eqe_q 是被跟踪量减去它的目标值，于是 θ˙q=eq e˙q\dot\theta_q=e_q\,\dot e_q；e˙q\dot e_q 在被跟踪量的切向量之外，只多出目标值本身的切向量（目标冻结时为零）。

A squared tracking objective is the special case θq=12eq2\theta_q=\tfrac12e_q^2, where eqe_q is the tracked quantity minus its target; then θ˙q=eq e˙q\dot\theta_q=e_q\,\dot e_q, and e˙q\dot e_q adds to the tangent of the tracked quantity only the tangent of the target itself (zero for a frozen target).

本页第 7 节的跟踪目标 Jq=12∑iWi(ui−uq,itgt)2J_q=\tfrac12\sum_iW_i(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})^2 正是平方跟踪型：求积点就是存储点，ωi=Wi\omega_i=W_i，θi=12(ui−uq,itgt)2\theta_i=\tfrac12(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})^2；目标场 uqtgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}_q 冻结，所以 θ˙i=(ui−uq,itgt) u˙i\dot\theta_i=(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})\,\dot u_i。它不显式依赖 DD，所以 ∇DJ=0\nabla_DJ=0。

The tracking objective Jq=12∑iWi(ui−uq,itgt)2J_q=\tfrac12\sum_iW_i(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})^2 of Section 7 is exactly of this form: the quadrature points are the stored points, ωi=Wi\omega_i=W_i and θi=12(ui−uq,itgt)2\theta_i=\tfrac12(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})^2; the target field uqtgtu^{\mathrm{tgt}}_q is frozen, so θ˙i=(ui−uq,itgt) u˙i\dot\theta_i=(u_i-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_{q,i})\,\dot u_i. It has no explicit dependence on DD, so ∇DJ=0\nabla_DJ=0.

求 gg 时固定所有设计变量；求 ∇DJ\nabla_DJ 时固定全部离散状态槽位。本页网格不随设计变化，采样点固定，所以没有位置依赖项。目标中的体积权重已经进入 gg，不应在伴随右端再乘一次体积。

Hold every design variable fixed for gg, and every stored state entry fixed for ∇DJ\nabla_DJ. The mesh of this page does not change with the design, so the samples are fixed and there is no location dependence. Objective volume weights already enter gg and must not be multiplied into the adjoint right-hand side again.

第 8 节Section 8

前向：沿着面循环传播切向量

Forward: propagate tangents through the face loop

本节实验：一次 tangent 计算给出残差对指定方向的变化，不是已经求出了状态对设计的敏感度。比较第 10 节的线性求解。

Experiment: One tangent application gives the residual change along a supplied direction. It is not yet the solved state sensitivity; compare the linear solve in Section 10.

矩阵乘法也可以写成方向导数

A matrix product can be evaluated as a directional derivative

令 u(α)=u+αvu(\alpha)=u+\alpha v，暂时固定设计输入 DD（D˙=0\dot D=0）。向量 vv 就是状态的切向量 u˙\dot u：它规定所有未知量同时沿哪个方向变化。对每个残差关于 α\alpha 求导，就得到残差的切向量 R˙=Av\dot R=Av。这只需要沿原来的计算过程应用链式法则，不必先存下整个矩阵；这就是 matrix-free（不显式组装矩阵）的含义，也就是自动微分的前向（tangent）模式：按原计算顺序，为每个中间量 xx 算出它的切向量 x˙\dot x。

Set u(α)=u+αvu(\alpha)=u+\alpha v while holding the design input DD fixed (D˙=0\dot D=0). The vector vv is the state tangent u˙\dot u: it specifies the direction in which all unknowns change together. Differentiating each residual with respect to α\alpha gives the residual tangent R˙=Av\dot R=Av. Apply the chain rule along the original computation without storing the full matrix: this is matrix-free evaluation, the forward (tangent) mode of automatic differentiation, which computes the tangent x˙\dot x of every intermediate xx in the order of the original computation.

记号：上点 x˙\dot x 与上横线 xˉ\bar x 是对离散程序求的前向与反向导数，与 Tapenade 等 AD 工具的变量 𝚡_𝚍\texttt{x\_d}、𝚡_𝚋\texttt{x\_b} 一一对应，下面的伪代码就这样命名。变分符号 δ\delta 只在附录 A 中出现，表示连续函数的变分。

Notation: the dot x˙\dot x and the bar xˉ\bar x are forward- and reverse-mode derivatives of the discrete program. They correspond one to one to the variables 𝚡_𝚍\texttt{x\_d} and 𝚡_𝚋\texttt{x\_b} of AD tools such as Tapenade, and the pseudocode below uses these names. The variation symbol δ\delta appears only in Appendix A, for variations of continuous functions.

R˙i=(Av)i=ddαRi(u+αv,D)∣α=0=∑j∂Ri∂ujvj.\dot R_i=(Av)_i=\left.\frac{d}{d\alpha}R_i(u+\alpha v,D)\right|_{\alpha=0}=\sum_j\frac{\partial R_i}{\partial u_j}v_j.

先看最小的一步：H(a,b)=(a2+b2)/4−ε(b−a)H(a,b)=(a^2+b^2)/4-\varepsilon(b-a)。分别对两个输入求偏导，再乘各自的切向量并相加，就是 H˙\dot H。在二阶格式中，a˙,b˙\dot a,\dot b 又来自重构，所以必须继续用链式法则传播到模板上的每个 vjv_j。

Start with the smallest operation, H(a,b)=(a2+b2)/4−ε(b−a)H(a,b)=(a^2+b^2)/4-\varepsilon(b-a). Differentiate with respect to each input, multiply by its tangent, then add to obtain H˙\dot H. At second order, the trace tangents a˙,b˙\dot a,\dot b themselves come from reconstruction, so continue the chain rule to every stencil value vjv_j.

cL=∂H∂a=a2+ε,cR=∂H∂b=b2−ε,H˙=cLa˙+cRb˙.c_L=\frac{\partial H}{\partial a}=\frac a2+\varepsilon,\quad c_R=\frac{\partial H}{\partial b}=\frac b2-\varepsilon,\quad\dot H=c_L\dot a+c_R\dot b.

手算一个面：取 a=1.1,b=1.2,ε=0.8a=1.1,b=1.2,\varepsilon=0.8，则 H=0.5825H=0.5825、cL=1.35,cR=−0.2c_L=1.35,c_R=-0.2。给切向量 a˙=0.3,b˙=−0.1\dot a=0.3,\dot b=-0.1，得到 H˙=0.425\dot H=0.425。左残差的切向量加 0.4250.425，右残差的切向量减 0.4250.425。这是一组局部演算数据，不是下方收敛流场中的固定面值。

Work one face by hand: with a=1.1,b=1.2,ε=0.8a=1.1,b=1.2,\varepsilon=0.8, obtain H=0.5825H=0.5825, cL=1.35,cR=−0.2c_L=1.35,c_R=-0.2. The tangents a˙=0.3,b˙=−0.1\dot a=0.3,\dot b=-0.1 give H˙=0.425\dot H=0.425. Add this to the tangent of the left residual and subtract it from the right one. These are illustrative local values, not fixed values of a face in the converged field below.

从状态切向量到通量切向量

From state tangents to flux tangents

令状态的切向量 𝐮˙=v\dot{\mathbf u}=v，设计固定（D˙=0\dot D=0）。无斜率限制器时，重构矩阵与状态无关，因此 q˙L=TLv\dot q_L=T_Lv、q˙R=TRv\dot q_R=T_Rv。链式法则必须经过重构、通量和分发三步。

Let the state tangent be 𝐮˙=v\dot{\mathbf u}=v with the design fixed (D˙=0\dot D=0). Without a limiter, reconstruction matrices are state independent, so q˙L=TLv\dot q_L=T_Lv and q˙R=TRv\dot q_R=T_Rv. The chain rule must pass through reconstruction, flux evaluation and residual scatter.

R˙=Aqv=ℬ[diag⁡(cL)TLv+diag⁡(cR)TRv].\dot R=A_qv=\mathcal B\left[\operatorname{diag}(c_L)T_Lv+\operatorname{diag}(c_R)T_Rv\right].

二阶时，一个面依赖哪些未知量

Which unknowns a second-order face depends on

对一个内部二阶面，重构系数和该面通量的完整导数如下。这里 cL,cRc_L,c_R 在重构面值上计算，不能在未经重构的中心值上计算。

For an interior second-order face, the reconstruction and complete flux derivative are as follows. Evaluate cL,cRc_L,c_R at the reconstructed face states, not at the unreconstructed centre values.

qL=−14ui−1+ui+14ui+1,qR=14ui+ui+1−14ui+2.q_L=-\frac14u_{i-1}+u_i+\frac14u_{i+1},\qquad q_R=\frac14u_i+u_{i+1}-\frac14u_{i+2}.
H˙f=−cL4vi−1+(cL+cR4)vi+(cL4+cR)vi+1−cR4vi+2.\dot H_f=-\frac{c_L}{4}v_{i-1}+\left(c_L+\frac{c_R}{4}\right)v_i+\left(\frac{c_L}{4}+c_R\right)v_{i+1}-\frac{c_R}{4}v_{i+2}.

边界附近的二阶迹用单边斜率：入口内侧迹 uinR=(3u0−u1)/2u_{in}^R=(3u_0-u_1)/2，第一内部面左迹 qL=(u0+u1)/2q_L=(u_0+u_1)/2，最后内部面右迹 qR=(uM−2+uM−1)/2q_R=(u_{M-2}+u_{M-1})/2，出口迹 uout=(3uM−1−uM−2)/2u_{out}=(3u_{M-1}-u_{M-2})/2；一阶时每个迹都取所在单元的值。出口物理通量的切向量为 uoutu˙outu_{out}\dot u_{out}，u˙out\dot u_{out} 按同一组权重传播。下面的播放器使用这些边界模板；上面的四点式只用于内部面。

Near the boundaries the second-order traces use one-sided slopes: inlet interior trace uinR=(3u0−u1)/2u_{in}^R=(3u_0-u_1)/2, left trace of the first interior face qL=(u0+u1)/2q_L=(u_0+u_1)/2, right trace of the last interior face qR=(uM−2+uM−1)/2q_R=(u_{M-2}+u_{M-1})/2, and outlet trace uout=(3uM−1−uM−2)/2u_{out}=(3u_{M-1}-u_{M-2})/2; at first order each trace is the value of its cell. The outlet physical-flux tangent is uoutu˙outu_{out}\dot u_{out}, with u˙out\dot u_{out} propagated through the same weights. The player below uses these boundary stencils; the four-point formula above applies only to interior faces.

播放器中的 vj=sin⁡(j+0.3)v_j=\sin(j+0.3) 是为了观察乘积而指定的测试种子 u˙=v\dot u=v，还不是第 10 节要求解的物理前向解。若选择单位向量 v=ejv=e_j，结果就是 Jacobian 的第 jj 列；一般 vv 是这些列的线性组合。伪代码就是 AD 工具生成的前向代码 𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚒𝚍𝚞𝚊𝚕_𝚍\texttt{residual\_d} 的样子：输入种子 𝚞_𝚍≡u˙\texttt{u\_d}\equiv\dot u，输出 𝚛𝚎𝚜_𝚍≡R˙\texttt{res\_d}\equiv\dot R。

The player uses the test seed u˙=v\dot u=v with vj=sin⁡(j+0.3)v_j=\sin(j+0.3) to illustrate a product. It is not the physical tangent solution of Section 10. Choosing v=ejv=e_j would return column jj of the Jacobian; a general vector combines its columns. The pseudocode is what an AD tool generates as forward code 𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚒𝚍𝚞𝚊𝚕_𝚍\texttt{residual\_d}: input seed 𝚞_𝚍≡u˙\texttt{u\_d}\equiv\dot u, output 𝚛𝚎𝚜_𝚍≡R˙\texttt{res\_d}\equiv\dot R.

局部导数怎样组成全局 Jacobian

How local derivatives form the global Jacobian

固定网格和当前可微分支，把一个面的所有输入记为 zfz_f；它包括重构状态以及该通量需要的梯度、几何和边界数据。令 TfT_f、KfK_f 分别是 zfz_f 对存储状态和设计变量的导数，Hz,fH_{z,f} 是局部通量 Jacobian。于是每个残差行的导数按同一个有向面关联矩阵 ℬ\mathcal B 装配，这里的求和包括相应的边界通量映射。本页没有被替换的行，边界条件全部在边界面的通量里。前向模式按计算顺序传播切向量，状态种子是 v≡𝐮˙v\equiv\dot{\mathbf u}，设计种子是 D˙\dot D：

At fixed mesh and differentiable branch, let zfz_f collect all face inputs: reconstructed states and the gradients, geometry and boundary data required by the flux. Let TfT_f and KfK_f be the derivatives of zfz_f with respect to the stored states and the design variables, and Hz,fH_{z,f} the local flux Jacobian. Assemble each residual derivative with the same oriented face incidence ℬ\mathcal B, including the boundary flux maps. This page replaces no rows: every boundary condition sits in a boundary-face flux. Forward mode carries the tangents in the order of the computation, with the state seed v≡𝐮˙v\equiv\dot{\mathbf u} and the design seed D˙\dot D:

z˙f=Tfv+KfD˙,H˙f=Hz,fz˙f,R˙i=∑fℬifH˙f−S˙i,\dot z_f=T_fv+K_f\dot D,\quad\dot H_f=H_{z,f}\dot z_f,\quad \dot R_i=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\dot H_f-\dot S_i,
(A)ij=∑fℬifHz,f(Tf)j−∂Si∂uj,(RD)ik=∑fℬifHz,f(Kf)k−∂Si∂Dk.(A)_{ij}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{z,f}(T_f)_j-\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial u_j},\qquad (R_D)_{ik}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{z,f}(K_f)_k-\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial D_k}.

无体源项时 Si=0S_i=0。本页的设计变量不改变几何：源项与入口值的依赖进入 KfK_f 与 SiS_i。二阶重构使 TfT_f 连接更多邻居，因此精确 Jacobian 的模板变宽；matrix-free 仍只需依次执行这些局部乘积，不必存储全局矩阵。

Set Si=0S_i=0 when there is no volume source. The design variables of this page do not change the geometry: the dependence on the sources and the inlet value enters KfK_f and SiS_i. Second-order reconstruction connects TfT_f to more neighbours and widens the exact Jacobian stencil. Matrix-free evaluation performs these local products without storing the global matrix.

第 9 节Section 9

伴随：把同一个面循环倒过来

Adjoint: reverse the same face loop

本节实验：只给一个输出非零权重，预测反向影响能传到哪些输入；共享输入应累加所有路径。

Experiment: Seed one output and predict which inputs receive reverse contributions. Shared inputs accumulate every path.

先转置一个面的局部矩阵

First transpose the local matrix of one face

先忽略重构，一个内部面只有左右两个输入与两个残差贡献。前向局部矩阵如下：第二行是第一行的相反数，因为相同通量在右控制体里带负号。把这个小矩阵转置后作用在残差种子上，就自然得到先作差、再乘通量偏导的伴随步骤。

First omit reconstruction. One interior face has two inputs and two residual contributions. The second row of its forward matrix is the negative of the first because the right volume receives the negative flux. Applying the transpose of this small matrix to the residual seeds naturally gives the adjoint operations: subtract the seeds, then multiply by flux derivatives.

[R˙LR˙R]=[cLcR−cL−cR][a˙b˙],[aˉbˉ]=[cL−cLcR−cR][RˉLRˉR]=[cLcR]Hˉ,Hˉ=RˉL−RˉR.\begin{bmatrix}\dot R_L\\\dot R_R\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}c_L&c_R\\-c_L&-c_R\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}\dot a\\\dot b\end{bmatrix},\qquad \begin{bmatrix}\bar a\\\bar b\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}c_L&-c_L\\c_R&-c_R\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}\bar R_L\\\bar R_R\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}c_L\\c_R\end{bmatrix}\bar H,\qquad \bar H=\bar R_L-\bar R_R.

反向代码按与前向相反的顺序执行，每个输入的横线量都用 += 累加：由种子 RˉL=wL\bar R_L=w_L、RˉR=wR\bar R_R=w_R 先得到 Hˉ+=RˉL\bar H\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar R_L、Hˉ-=RˉR\bar H\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_R，再得到 aˉ+=cLHˉ\bar a\mathrel{\text{+=}}c_L\bar H、bˉ+=cRHˉ\bar b\mathrel{\text{+=}}c_R\bar H。给定第 8 节的局部数值，再取 wL=2,wR=−0.5w_L=2,w_R=-0.5，则 Hˉ=2.5\bar H=2.5、aˉ=3.375,bˉ=−0.5\bar a=3.375,\bar b=-0.5。检查对偶恒等式的两边：RˉLR˙L+RˉRR˙R=wLH˙+wR(−H˙)=1.0625\bar R_L\dot R_L+\bar R_R\dot R_R=w_L\dot H+w_R(-\dot H)=1.0625，而 aˉa˙+bˉb˙=1.0625\bar a\dot a+\bar b\dot b=1.0625。这就是转置关系在一个面上的具体含义。

The reverse code runs in the opposite order of the forward code and accumulates the bar of every input with +=: from the seeds RˉL=wL\bar R_L=w_L and RˉR=wR\bar R_R=w_R it forms Hˉ+=RˉL\bar H\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar R_L and Hˉ-=RˉR\bar H\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_R, then aˉ+=cLHˉ\bar a\mathrel{\text{+=}}c_L\bar H and bˉ+=cRHˉ\bar b\mathrel{\text{+=}}c_R\bar H. Use the local values from Section 8 and wL=2,wR=−0.5w_L=2,w_R=-0.5: then Hˉ=2.5\bar H=2.5, aˉ=3.375\bar a=3.375 and bˉ=−0.5\bar b=-0.5. Both sides of the duality identity agree: RˉLR˙L+RˉRR˙R=wLH˙+wR(−H˙)=1.0625\bar R_L\dot R_L+\bar R_R\dot R_R=w_L\dot H+w_R(-\dot H)=1.0625 and aˉa˙+bˉb˙=1.0625\bar a\dot a+\bar b\dot b=1.0625. This is the transpose identity on a single face.

为什么二阶必须累加到远邻

Why second order reaches beyond the two neighbours

如果 a=−ui−1/4+ui+ui+1/4a=-u_{i-1}/4+u_i+u_{i+1}/4，反向传播就给这三个未知量的伴随分别累加：uˉi−1+=−aˉ/4\bar u_{i-1}\mathrel{\text{+=}}-\bar a/4、uˉi+=aˉ\bar u_i\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar a、uˉi+1+=aˉ/4\bar u_{i+1}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar a/4。右迹也做同样的事。某个未知量可能从多个面、同一面的两条重构路径收到贡献，因此必须使用“+=”，不能后到的贡献覆盖先到的贡献。

For a=−ui−1/4+ui+ui+1/4a=-u_{i-1}/4+u_i+u_{i+1}/4, reverse propagation adds to the adjoints of those three unknowns: uˉi−1+=−aˉ/4\bar u_{i-1}\mathrel{\text{+=}}-\bar a/4, uˉi+=aˉ\bar u_i\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar a and uˉi+1+=aˉ/4\bar u_{i+1}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar a/4. Apply the same rule to the right trace. An unknown can receive contributions from several faces and from both reconstruction paths on one face, so use += rather than overwriting earlier contributions.

从残差权重返回状态权重

From residual weights back to state weights

伴随是同一条计算链按相反顺序的转置。以残差种子 Rˉ=w\bar R=w 出发：先收集每个面上通量的伴随 Hˉf=wL−wR\bar H_f=w_L-w_R；再乘通量偏导，得到左右迹的伴随 qˉL=cLHˉf\bar q_L=c_L\bar H_f、qˉR=cRHˉf\bar q_R=c_R\bar H_f；最后通过 TLT,TRTT_L^T,T_R^T 累加（+=）到所有受影响未知量的伴随 𝐮ˉ\bar{\mathbf u}。不能只把结果放回面两侧的中心。

The adjoint is the transpose of the same chain, run in reverse order. Start from the residual seed Rˉ=w\bar R=w: gather the adjoint of each face flux, Hˉf=wL−wR\bar H_f=w_L-w_R; multiply by the two flux derivatives to get the trace adjoints qˉL=cLHˉf\bar q_L=c_L\bar H_f and qˉR=cRHˉf\bar q_R=c_R\bar H_f; then accumulate (+=) through TLT,TRTT_L^T,T_R^T into the adjoint 𝐮ˉ\bar{\mathbf u} of every affected unknown. Returning contributions only to the two adjacent centres would omit reconstruction derivatives.

𝐮ˉ=AqTw=TLT[cL⊙(ℬTw)]+TRT[cR⊙(ℬTw)],ℬTw=(Hˉf)f.\bar{\mathbf u}=A_q^Tw=T_L^T\left[c_L\odot(\mathcal B^Tw)\right]+T_R^T\left[c_R\odot(\mathcal B^Tw)\right],\qquad \mathcal B^Tw=(\bar H_f)_f.

入口面怎样反向求导

Differentiating the inlet face in reverse

格心入口面只有右侧控制体：R0R_0 中含 −Hin-H_{in}，所以入口面通量的伴随是 Hˉin=−w0\bar H_{in}=-w_0。外侧状态 a=uina=u_{in} 是设计输入，不对应任何状态分量；内侧迹 uinRu_{in}^R 的伴随 cRinHˉinc_R^{in}\bar H_{in} 按重构权重累加到 uˉ0,uˉ1\bar u_0,\bar u_1，一阶时 (β0,β1)=(1,0)(\beta_0,\beta_1)=(1,0)，二阶时为 (32,−12)(\tfrac32,-\tfrac12)。取 w=ψw=\psi 时，外侧一项 uˉin\bar u_{in} 就是第 12 节的入口导数 dJ/duin=−cLinψ0dJ/du_{in}=-c_L^{in}\psi_0。这个入口面也是第 16 节入口伴随边界层的来源。

The cell inlet face has a control volume on its right only: R0R_0 contains −Hin-H_{in}, so the adjoint of the inlet flux is Hˉin=−w0\bar H_{in}=-w_0. The exterior state a=uina=u_{in} is a design input and belongs to no state component; the interior-trace adjoint cRinHˉinc_R^{in}\bar H_{in} accumulates into uˉ0,uˉ1\bar u_0,\bar u_1 through the reconstruction weights, (β0,β1)=(1,0)(\beta_0,\beta_1)=(1,0) at first order and (32,−12)(\tfrac32,-\tfrac12) at second order. With w=ψw=\psi the exterior term uˉin\bar u_{in} is the inlet derivative of Section 12, dJ/duin=−cLinψ0dJ/du_{in}=-c_L^{in}\psi_0. This inlet face is also the source of the inlet adjoint boundary layer discussed in Section 16.

Hˉin=−w0,uˉin=cLinHˉin=−cLinw0,uˉ0+=β0cRinHˉin,uˉ1+=β1cRinHˉin.\bar H_{in}=-w_0,\qquad \bar u_{in}=c_L^{in}\bar H_{in}=-c_L^{in}w_0,\qquad \bar u_0\mathrel{\text{+=}}\beta_0c_R^{in}\bar H_{in},\quad \bar u_1\mathrel{\text{+=}}\beta_1c_R^{in}\bar H_{in}.

点积检验 wT(Aqv)=vT(AqTw)w^T(A_qv)=v^T(A_q^Tw)，即 AD 的对偶恒等式 RˉTR˙=𝐮˙T𝐮ˉ\bar R^T\dot R=\dot{\mathbf u}^T\bar{\mathbf u}，检查转置关系，但两个方向若同时漏掉重构，仍可能通过。第 14 节会用独立复数残差和总导数再做检验。

The dot test wT(Aqv)=vT(AqTw)w^T(A_qv)=v^T(A_q^Tw), the AD duality identity RˉTR˙=𝐮˙T𝐮ˉ\bar R^T\dot R=\dot{\mathbf u}^T\bar{\mathbf u}, checks transposition, but can pass if both operators omit reconstruction. Section 14 additionally checks an independent complex residual and total derivatives.

“倒过来”指依赖链的次序反转，不要求把相互独立的面编号倒序遍历。这里每个面读取固定的 uu 与种子 ww，并向独立的输出数组 uˉ\bar u 累加，正序或倒序遍历面都给出同一线性算子（浮点舍入次序可有微小差异）。GS 的行更新会读刚写入的新值，因而其反向扫描是另一件必须明确处理的事。伪代码就是 AD 工具生成的反向代码 𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚒𝚍𝚞𝚊𝚕_𝚋\texttt{residual\_b} 的样子：种子 𝚛𝚎𝚜_𝚋≡Rˉ\texttt{res\_b}\equiv\bar R，输出 𝚞_𝚋≡uˉ\texttt{u\_b}\equiv\bar u。

Reversal concerns dependency order, not necessarily the numbering of independent faces. Here each face reads the fixed uu and seed ww and adds to a separate output array uˉ\bar u; either face order gives the same linear operator up to rounding. GS row updates read freshly written values, so reversing their scan is a separate issue that must be treated explicitly. The pseudocode is what an AD tool generates as reverse code 𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚒𝚍𝚞𝚊𝚕_𝚋\texttt{residual\_b}: seed 𝚛𝚎𝚜_𝚋≡Rˉ\texttt{res\_b}\equiv\bar R, output 𝚞_𝚋≡uˉ\texttt{u\_b}\equiv\bar u.

为什么反向累加给出矩阵转置

Why reverse accumulation gives the matrix transpose

把所有残差和状态分量展平后，下面只是交换两个有限求和的次序。残差种子 Rˉ=w\bar R=w 是任意给定的，尚未求解伴随方程；只有选择满足第 11 节线性方程的 w=ψw=\psi，才得到该目标对应的离散伴随解。取 D˙=0\dot D=0、𝐮˙=v\dot{\mathbf u}=v，前向得到 R˙=Av\dot R=Av；以 Rˉ=w\bar R=w 为种子反向扫描，得到 𝐮ˉ=ATw\bar{\mathbf u}=A^Tw。下式就是 AD 的对偶（点积）恒等式：

After flattening all residual and state components, the following simply exchanges two finite sums. The residual seed Rˉ=w\bar R=w is arbitrary and has not solved an adjoint equation; only w=ψw=\psi satisfying Section 11 gives the discrete adjoint solution for the chosen objective. With D˙=0\dot D=0 and 𝐮˙=v\dot{\mathbf u}=v the forward sweep gives R˙=Av\dot R=Av; the reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ=w\bar R=w gives 𝐮ˉ=ATw\bar{\mathbf u}=A^Tw. The identity below is the duality (dot-product) identity of AD:

RˉTR˙=wT(Av)=∑r=1nu∑j=1nuwr∂Rr∂ujvj=∑j=1nuvj(∑r=1nu∂Rr∂ujwr)=vT(ATw)=𝐮˙T𝐮ˉ.\bar R^T\dot R=w^T(Av)=\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}w_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial u_j}v_j=\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}v_j\left(\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial u_j}w_r\right)=v^T(A^Tw)=\dot{\mathbf u}^T\bar{\mathbf u}.

内部面通量向左加、向右减，所以先把这两条路径合并成通量的伴随 Hˉf\bar H_f；之后按通量、重构、原始状态的相反依赖顺序传播。反向语句中的 += 很重要：同一状态会被多个面和多个求积点读取，这些贡献必须累加。这里没有分部积分，也没有另行猜测连续伴随边界条件。

An interior flux is added on the left and subtracted on the right, so combine those two paths into its adjoint Hˉf\bar H_f before reversing fluxes, reconstruction and stored states. The += is essential: multiple faces and quadrature points read the same state, and their contributions must accumulate. There is no integration by parts and no separately guessed continuous adjoint boundary condition.

RL+=Hf, RR-=Hf⟹Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR=wL−wR,uf=∑jWfjuj⟹uˉj+=WfjTuˉf.R_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f,\ R_R\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R=w_L-w_R,\qquad u_f=\sum_jW_{fj}u_j\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\bar u_j\mathrel{\text{+=}}W_{fj}^T\bar u_f.

第 8 节局部链里的每个切向量都有对应的伴随。反向语句按与前向相反的顺序执行，每个输入的横线量都用 += 累加：

Every tangent of the local chain of Section 8 has its adjoint. The reverse statements run in the opposite order of the forward ones, and the bar of every input accumulates with +=:

Hˉf=∑iℬifRˉi,Sˉi=−Rˉi,zˉf=Hz,fTHˉf,𝐮ˉ+=TfTzˉf,Dˉ+=KfTzˉf+(∂S∂D)TSˉ.\bar H_f=\sum_i\mathcal B_{if}\bar R_i,\quad \bar S_i=-\bar R_i,\quad \bar z_f=H_{z,f}^T\bar H_f,\quad \bar{\mathbf u}\mathrel{\text{+=}}T_f^T\bar z_f,\quad \bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}K_f^T\bar z_f+\Big(\frac{\partial S}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar S.

本页没有被替换的残差行：边界条件都在边界面的通量里，所以上面的面循环转置就是完整的 ATA^T。

This page replaces no residual rows: the boundary conditions all sit in boundary-face fluxes, so the transposed face loop above is the complete ATA^T.

第 10 节Section 10

前向求解：设计改变后，解怎样变化

Forward solve: how the solution changes with the design

从方向乘积到一个需要求解的方程

From a directional product to an equation to solve

前面可以对任意向量 vv 计算 AvAv。现在给设计输入一个种子（方向）D˙\dot D：状态也随之变化，它的切向量是 u˙\dot u，且新状态仍要满足 R(u(D),D)=0R(u(D),D)=0。对这个恒等式前向求导（多元链式法则），得到两部分：经状态切向量的间接影响与设计直接进入残差的影响。

We can now evaluate AvAv for any supplied vv. Now seed the design input with a direction D˙\dot D: the state changes too, with tangent u˙\dot u, and must still satisfy R(u(D),D)=0R(u(D),D)=0. Differentiating this identity in forward mode (the multivariable chain rule) gives two terms: the indirect effect through the state tangent and the direct design effect in the residual.

0=R˙=Ru u˙+RD D˙=Aqv+f,f=RDD˙,v≡u˙.0=\dot R=R_u\,\dot u+R_D\,\dot D=A_qv+f,\qquad f=R_D\dot D,\quad v\equiv\dot u.

例如取种子 D˙=ek\dot D=e_k，即格心第 kk 个源项增加一个单位的方向，只有直接项 fk=−hf_k=-h 非零；随后 vv 的多个分量会响应。这区分了“输入在哪里施加”和“影响传播到哪里”。先固定收敛的原始解，再求这个线性系统，最后用 J˙=gTv\dot J=g^Tv 得到目标的方向导数。

For example, the seed D˙=ek\dot D=e_k, a unit change in cell source kk, gives a direct term fk=−hf_k=-h with other components zero, yet many state components can respond in vv. This separates where the input is applied from where its effects propagate. Freeze the converged primal state, solve the linear system, then obtain the objective directional derivative as J˙=gTv\dot J=g^Tv.

沿设计种子 D˙\dot D 对收敛残差 Rq(u(D),D)=0R_q(u(D),D)=0 前向求导，令 f=Rq,DD˙f=R_{q,D}\dot D，得到精确 tangent 方程，它的解是状态切向量 v≡𝐮˙v\equiv\dot{\mathbf u}。在该线性求解期间固定原始解、AqA_q 和一阶预处理矩阵 PP；修正量 Δv\Delta v 是迭代的增量，不是导数。

Differentiate the converged residual Rq(u(D),D)=0R_q(u(D),D)=0 forward along the design seed D˙\dot D and set f=Rq,DD˙f=R_{q,D}\dot D. The exact tangent equation below has the state tangent v≡𝐮˙v\equiv\dot{\mathbf u} as its solution. The primal state, exact AqA_q and first-order preconditioning matrix PP remain fixed during this linear solve; the correction Δv\Delta v is an iteration increment, not a derivative.

Aqv=−f,rt=Aqv+f,PΔv=−rt,vm+1=vm+ω Δv.A_qv=-f,\qquad r_t=A_qv+f,\qquad P\Delta v=-r_t,\qquad v^{m+1}=v^m+\omega\,\Delta v.

用一阶 Jacobian 求二阶方程的修正

A first-order Jacobian for corrections to the second-order equation

每次修正方程从零开始，用所选次数的 GS 扫描，得到线性算子 Bs≈P−1B_s\approx P^{-1}。一次扫描时 B1=(diag⁡(P)+L)−1B_1=(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)^{-1}。精确求出修正方程时，可以把这一缺陷校正写成 Pvm+1=−f−(Aq−P)vmPv^{m+1}=-f-(A_q-P)v^m（ω=1\omega=1）；有限次 GS 时应使用下面的实际迭代式。

Starting each correction from zero and taking the selected fixed number of GS sweeps defines a linear operator Bs≈P−1B_s\approx P^{-1}. One sweep gives B1=(diag⁡(P)+L)−1B_1=(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)^{-1}. If the correction is solved exactly, this defect correction becomes Pvm+1=−f−(Aq−P)vmPv^{m+1}=-f-(A_q-P)v^m for ω=1\omega=1; with finite GS sweeps, the actual iteration is the following.

vm+1=vm−ωBs(Aqvm+f),em+1=(I−ωBsAq)em.v^{m+1}=v^m-\omega B_s(A_qv^m+f),\qquad e^{m+1}=(I-\omega B_sA_q)e^m.

收敛需要误差传播矩阵的谱半径小于 1；GS 或低阶预处理并不对任意二阶问题保证收敛。下面可更换设计变量，查看解及真实线性残差。

Convergence requires a spectral radius below 1 for the error propagator; GS or low-order preconditioning does not guarantee convergence for arbitrary second-order problems. Select a design variable below and inspect the solution and true linear residual.

前向固定点求解：每次检查精确线性残差

Forward fixed point: check the exact linear residual each time

f = design_derivative(u, D_d)          # D_d is the design seed Ḋ
v = zeros(M); P = first_order_jacobian(u)
repeat:
    r = forward_product(u, v) + f      # A v + f, one forward sweep
    if norm(r) <= tolerance: return v
    delta = GS(P, -r, zero_start, fixed_sweep_count)   # the correction Δv
    v = v + omega*delta

一次 GS 应用把右端向量变成修正，记为线性映射 BsB_s。将更新式代入误差 em=vm−v∗e^m=v^m-v^*，就得到误差传播矩阵；其谱半径小于 1 才保证对任意初始误差收敛。残差曲线可以观察本次求解，但不能替代一般收敛条件。

One GS application maps a right-hand side to a correction; call this linear map BsB_s. Substitute the update into em=vm−v∗e^m=v^m-v^* to obtain the error propagation matrix. A spectral radius below 1 guarantees convergence for every initial error. A residual plot describes this solve, not a general convergence theorem.

把隐函数求导展开成可求解的系统

Expand implicit differentiation into a solvable system

设原始残差已经收敛，且当前光滑分支上的 AA 非奇异。取设计种子（方向）D˙\dot D，令 D(t)=D+t D˙D(t)=D+t\,\dot D；前向求解得到的状态切向量是 v≡𝐮˙=ddt𝐮(D+t D˙)∣t=0v\equiv\dot{\mathbf u}=\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf u(D+t\,\dot D)\big|_{t=0}。对每一个残差分量逐项求导，零残差的切向量仍为零：

Assume the primal residual is converged and AA is nonsingular on the current smooth branch. Choose a design seed (direction) D˙\dot D and set D(t)=D+t D˙D(t)=D+t\,\dot D; the state tangent returned by the tangent solve is v≡𝐮˙=ddt𝐮(D+t D˙)∣t=0v\equiv\dot{\mathbf u}=\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf u(D+t\,\dot D)\big|_{t=0}. Differentiate each residual component: the tangent of a zero residual is zero.

0=R˙r=∑j∂Rr∂ujvj+∑k∂Rr∂DkD˙k(1≤r≤nu)⟹Av=−RD D˙.0=\dot R_r=\sum_j\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial u_j}v_j+\sum_k\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial D_k}\dot D_k\quad(1\le r\le n_u)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad Av=-R_D\,\dot D.
J^(D)=J(𝐮(D),D),J˙=ddtJ^(D+t D˙)∣t=0=gTv+(∇DJ)T D˙.\widehat{J}(D)=J(\mathbf u(D),D),\qquad \dot J=\frac{d}{dt}\widehat{J}(D+t\,\dot D)\Big|_{t=0}=g^Tv+(\nabla_DJ)^T\,\dot D.

实现分三步：状态种子 𝐮˙=0\dot{\mathbf u}=0、设计种子 D˙\dot D，前向求值残差得到 R˙=RD D˙\dot R=R_D\,\dot D；用精确 AA 的乘积求解 vv；再以 𝐮˙=v\dot{\mathbf u}=v 和 D˙\dot D 为种子对目标前向求导，得到 J˙\dot J。一次 AvAv 只是算子调用（一次前向扫描），不是求解 vv。稳态导数的对象是收敛残差方程，不是 GS／GMRES 的迭代次数。在不可微点（如 limiter 的切换或分支判别处）以上普通导数需要另外讨论，不能无条件套用。

Implementation has three steps: seed the state with 𝐮˙=0\dot{\mathbf u}=0 and the design with D˙\dot D and evaluate the residual tangent R˙=RD D˙\dot R=R_D\,\dot D; solve for vv with exact AA products; then differentiate the objective forward with the seeds 𝐮˙=v\dot{\mathbf u}=v and D˙\dot D to obtain J˙\dot J. One AvAv is an operator application (one forward sweep), not the solution vv. The steady derivative concerns the converged residual equation, not the GS/GMRES iteration count. At nondifferentiable points (a limiter switch or a branch test) these ordinary derivatives need separate treatment.

第 11 节Section 11

伴随求解：从目标函数向回传递

Adjoint solve: propagate back from the objective

为什么转置方程能省去很多前向求解

Why a transpose solve avoids many forward solves

如果有很多设计变量而只关心一个 JJ，逐个计算 vv 要解很多线性系统。利用 Av=−fAv=-f，找一个 ψ\psi 使 ATψ=−gA^T\psi=-g，便可把 gTvg^Tv 改写为只含 ff 的内积。整个推导只用矩阵转置恒等式。

With many design variables but one objective, solving for each vv requires many linear systems. Given Av=−fAv=-f, choose ψ\psi satisfying ATψ=−gA^T\psi=-g. A transpose identity rewrites gTvg^Tv as an inner product with ff, eliminating vv.

J˙=gTv=(−ATψ)Tv=−ψTAv=ψTf.\dot J=g^Tv=(-A^T\psi)^Tv=-\psi^TAv=\psi^Tf.

这里的两个负号相消。也可以采用相反号的伴随变量，但方程和梯度公式必须一起改变。本页统一用 ℒ=J+ψTR\mathcal L=J+\psi^TR，所以右端是 −g-g。伴随不是原始流场倒着求一次，而是一个由目标梯度驱动的转置线性问题。

The two minus signs cancel. An opposite adjoint sign convention is possible, but the equation and gradient formula must both change. This page uses ℒ=J+ψTR\mathcal L=J+\psi^TR, giving right-hand side −g-g. The adjoint is a transpose linear problem driven by the objective gradient, not the primal flow solved backwards.

ψ 的含义：给一个控制体多加一点源项

What ψ means: add a little source to one control volume

把控制体 ii 的积分源项增加一个数 τ\tau，第 ii 行变成 Ri=Hi+1/2−Hi−1/2−(Si+τ)R_i=H_{i+1/2}-H_{i-1/2}-(S_i+\tau)，其余行不变。这等于求解 R(u,D)=τeiR(u,D)=\tau e_i。按前向模式，给源项一个单位种子 S˙=ei\dot S=e_i（其余种子为零）：残差的切向量 R˙=A𝐮˙−S˙\dot R=A\dot{\mathbf u}-\dot S 必须为零，所以 A𝐮˙=eiA\dot{\mathbf u}=e_i；再用伴随方程 ATψ=−gA^T\psi=-g，即 ψT=−gTA−1\psi^T=-g^TA^{-1}：

Increase the integrated source of control volume ii by a number τ\tau: row ii becomes Ri=Hi+1/2−Hi−1/2−(Si+τ)R_i=H_{i+1/2}-H_{i-1/2}-(S_i+\tau) and the other rows are unchanged. This is the same as solving R(u,D)=τeiR(u,D)=\tau e_i. In forward mode, give the source the unit seed S˙=ei\dot S=e_i (all other seeds zero): the residual tangent R˙=A𝐮˙−S˙\dot R=A\dot{\mathbf u}-\dot S must vanish, so A𝐮˙=eiA\dot{\mathbf u}=e_i; the adjoint equation ATψ=−gA^T\psi=-g, i.e. ψT=−gTA−1\psi^T=-g^TA^{-1}, then gives

J˙=gT𝐮˙=gTA−1ei=−ψTei=−ψi⟹ψi=−∂J∂Si.\dot J=g^T\dot{\mathbf u}=g^TA^{-1}e_i=-\psi^Te_i=-\psi_i\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\psi_i=-\frac{\partial J}{\partial S_i}.

所以 ψi\psi_i 是“控制体 ii 多注入单位积分源项时目标函数减少多少”。负号来自残差约定“流出减流入减源项”。若源项密度在宽度为 WiW_i 的控制体上均匀增加、种子为 s˙\dot s，则 S˙i=Wis˙\dot S_i=W_i\dot s，于是 J˙=−Wiψi s˙\dot J=-W_i\psi_i\,\dot s。格心页 Si=hσiS_i=h\sigma_i，这正是第 12 节的 dJ/dσi=−hψidJ/d\sigma_i=-h\psi_i。图 10不用伴随，直接测量这个关系：对每个 ii 解两次完整的非线性方程 R(u,D)=±τeiR(u,D)=\pm\tau e_i（步长 τ=1×10−4\tau=1\times10^{-4} 是一个数），用中心差分得到 −[J(τ)−J(−τ)]/(2τ)-[J(\tau)-J(-\tau)]/(2\tau)。两者的最大相对差是 2.7×10−82.7\times10^{-8}，正是中心差分 O(τ2)O(\tau^2) 截断误差的量级。

So ψi\psi_i is the decrease of the objective when one unit of integrated source is injected into control volume ii. The minus sign comes from the residual convention "outflow minus inflow minus source". If the source density rises evenly over a volume of width WiW_i with the seed s˙\dot s, then S˙i=Wis˙\dot S_i=W_i\dot s and J˙=−Wiψi s˙\dot J=-W_i\psi_i\,\dot s. On the cell page Si=hσiS_i=h\sigma_i, which is exactly dJ/dσi=−hψidJ/d\sigma_i=-h\psi_i of Section 12. Figure 10 measures this relation without the adjoint: for every ii it solves the full nonlinear equations R(u,D)=±τeiR(u,D)=\pm\tau e_i twice (the step τ=1×10−4\tau=1\times10^{-4} is a number) and forms the central difference −[J(τ)−J(−τ)]/(2τ)-[J(\tau)-J(-\tau)]/(2\tau). The largest relative difference is 2.7×10−82.7\times10^{-8}, the size of the O(τ2)O(\tau^2) truncation error of a central difference.

图中的两个箭头说明方向。在 xix_i 注入的源项沿流动改变下游的 uu；JJ 在每个控制体测量失配 gj=Wj(uj−ujtgt)g_j=W_j(u_j-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_j)（橙色柱），所以 ψi\psi_i 汇总的是 xix_i 下游的失配。出口附近下游几乎没有控制体，ψ\psi 很小；向入口方向每经过一个失配为负的控制体，ψ\psi 就增大，经过失配为正的控制体（这里在入口附近）则减小。这就是伴随“从目标函数向回传递”的含义，也是连续伴随从 λ(1)=0\lambda(1)=0 出发、向入口积分的离散版本。

The two arrows give the directions. A source injected at xix_i changes uu downstream along the flow; JJ measures the mismatch gj=Wj(uj−ujtgt)g_j=W_j(u_j-u^{\mathrm{tgt}}_j) in every volume (orange bars), so ψi\psi_i collects the mismatch downstream of xix_i. Near the outlet almost nothing lies downstream and ψ\psi is small; moving toward the inlet, ψ\psi grows across every volume with a negative mismatch and shrinks across a volume with a positive one (here near the inlet). This is what "propagating back from the objective" means, and it is the discrete counterpart of integrating the continuous adjoint from λ(1)=0\lambda(1)=0 toward the inlet.

采用拉格朗日函数 ℒ=J+ψTRq\mathcal L=J+\psi^TR_q，令 ℒ˙\dot{\mathcal L} 中状态切向量 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} 的系数为零，得到 AqTψ=−gA_q^T\psi=-g。修正方程使用 PTP^T，并按相反方向扫描；修正量记作 Δψ\Delta\psi。

With ℒ=J+ψTRq\mathcal L=J+\psi^TR_q, setting the coefficient of the state tangent 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} in ℒ˙\dot{\mathcal L} to zero gives AqTψ=−gA_q^T\psi=-g. The correction uses PTP^T, scans in the opposite direction and is written Δψ\Delta\psi.

PTΔψ=−(AqTψ+g),(diag⁡(P)+LT)Δψ(ℓ+1)=−(AqTψ+g)−UTΔψ(ℓ).P^T\Delta\psi=-(A_q^T\psi+g),\qquad (\operatorname{diag}(P)+L^T)\Delta\psi^{(\ell+1)}=-(A_q^T\psi+g)-U^T\Delta\psi^{(\ell)}.

相同固定次数、零初值的反向扫描恰好构成 BsTB_s^T，不是把矩阵转置后仍沿原方向扫描。于是实际更新和误差传播如下。

With the same fixed sweep count and zero initial correction, reverse sweeps implement BsTB_s^T. Transposing the matrix while retaining the original sweep direction would give a different preconditioner. The actual update and error propagation are therefore:

ψm+1=ψm−ωBsT(AqTψm+g),eam+1=(I−ωBsTAqT)eam.\psi^{m+1}=\psi^m-\omega B_s^T(A_q^T\psi^m+g),\qquad e_a^{m+1}=(I-\omega B_s^TA_q^T)e_a^m.

注意 I−ωBsTAqTI-\omega B_s^TA_q^T 并不直接等于 tangent 迭代矩阵的转置，因为乘法顺序不同。这里解的是残差伴随变量 ψ\psi；若逆向微分整个迭代程序，需要额外说明其迭代伴随变量与 ψ\psi 的转换。

Note that I−ωBsTAqTI-\omega B_s^TA_q^T is not directly the transpose of the tangent iteration matrix: the multiplication order differs. We solve for the residual adjoint ψ\psi. Reverse differentiation of the entire iteration program would require an additional relation between its iterative adjoint variable and ψ\psi.

伴随固定点求解与反向 GS

Adjoint fixed point and reverse GS

g = objective_state_gradient(u)
psi = zeros(M); PT = transpose(first_order_jacobian(u))
repeat:
    r = adjoint_product(u, psi) + g    # A^T psi + g, one reverse sweep seeded with psi
    if norm(r) <= tolerance: return psi
    delta = zeros(M)                   # the correction Δψ
    repeat fixed_number_of_sweeps:
        for i = M-1,...,0:
            delta[i] = (-r[i] - Σ(j≠i) PT[i,j]*delta[j]) / PT[i,i]
    psi = psi + omega*delta

一轮正向 GS 解下三角系统 (diag⁡(P)+L)x=b(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)x=b，所以 B1=(diag⁡(P)+L)−1B_1=(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)^{-1}；转置后是 B1T=(diag⁡(P)+LT)−1B_1^T=(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L^T)^{-1}，这是上三角系统，需要从最后一行往前解。对固定的多轮扫描，同样需要转置整个零初值映射，而不只是矩阵名加一个 T。下方检验也比较 wTBsvw^TB_sv 与 vTBsTwv^TB_s^Tw。

One forward GS sweep solves (diag⁡(P)+L)x=b(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)x=b, so B1=(diag⁡(P)+L)−1B_1=(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L)^{-1}. Its transpose is B1T=(diag⁡(P)+LT)−1B_1^T=(\operatorname{diag}(P)+L^T)^{-1}, an upper-triangular solve performed from the last row backwards. With several fixed sweeps, transpose the entire zero-start map, not merely the matrix name. The page also checks wTBsv=vTBsTww^TB_sv=v^TB_s^Tw.

下面的动画用伴随 GS 固定点求解 ATψ=−gA^T\psi=-g（不论页首选择哪种线性求解器，这里都是 GS）。先逐行播放第一次修正：反向扫描从最后一行走到第 0 行，ψ\psi 从出口一侧开始出现，逐步延伸到入口。这与图 10的方向一致，也与连续伴随从 λ(1)=0\lambda(1)=0 出发、向入口积分的方向相同。之后每帧是一次外层迭代，下方的误差柱是出口一侧先变短；与上面的原始动画一样，迭代越过停止准则，一直做到残差停在舍入平台上。

The animation below solves ATψ=−gA^T\psi=-g with the adjoint GS fixed point (GS here whatever linear solver is selected at the top). The first correction is played row by row: the reverse sweep runs from the last row to row 0, so ψ\psi appears on the outlet side first and extends toward the inlet. This is the direction of Figure 10, and the direction in which the continuous adjoint is integrated from λ(1)=0\lambda(1)=0 toward the inlet. After that, each frame is one outer iteration, and the error bars below shrink on the outlet side first; as in the primal animation, the iteration continues past the stopping criterion until the residual rests on its round-off floor.

从有限维 Lagrangian 逐步消去状态敏感度

Eliminate state sensitivity from a finite-dimensional Lagrangian

ℒ(𝐮,D,ψ)=J(𝐮,D)+ψTR(𝐮,D).\mathcal L(\mathbf u,D,\psi)=J(\mathbf u,D)+\psi^TR(\mathbf u,D).

在满足 R=0R=0 的解上 ℒ=J\mathcal L=J。先把 ψ\psi 固定，沿切向量 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u}、D˙\dot D 对 ℒ\mathcal L 前向求导，再按 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} 和 D˙\dot D 收集系数。即使 ψ\psi 随设计改变，额外的 ψ˙TR\dot\psi^TR 项也在收敛解上为零。

At a feasible state R=0R=0, ℒ=J\mathcal L=J. Hold ψ\psi fixed, differentiate ℒ\mathcal L forward along the tangents 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} and D˙\dot D, then collect the coefficients of 𝐮˙\dot{\mathbf u} and D˙\dot D. Even if ψ\psi varies with the design, the extra ψ˙TR\dot\psi^TR term vanishes at the converged state.

ℒ˙=gT𝐮˙+(∇DJ)TD˙+ψT(A𝐮˙+RDD˙)=(g+ATψ)T𝐮˙+(∇DJ+RDTψ)TD˙.\dot{\mathcal L}=g^T\dot{\mathbf u}+(\nabla_DJ)^T\dot D+\psi^T(A\dot{\mathbf u}+R_D\dot D)=(g+A^T\psi)^T\dot{\mathbf u}+(\nabla_DJ+R_D^T\psi)^T\dot D.

选择 ψ\psi 使未知的状态敏感度前面的系数为零。于是一个目标只需求解一次伴随线性系统，再进行设计反传；总设计梯度是列向量 ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J。注意符号来自这里的加号约定，并不是因为“伴随一定带负号”。

Choose ψ\psi to cancel the coefficient of the unknown state sensitivity. One objective then requires one adjoint solve followed by design reverse accumulation; the total design gradient ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J is a column. Its sign follows from the plus convention in this Lagrangian, not from a universal negative sign for adjoints.

ATψ=−g,∇DJ^=∇DJ+RDTψ,dJ^dDk=∂J∂Dk+∑rψr∂Rr∂Dk.\boxed{A^T\psi=-g},\qquad\boxed{\nabla_D\widehat J=\nabla_DJ+R_D^T\psi},\qquad \frac{d\widehat J}{dD_k}=\frac{\partial J}{\partial D_k}+\sum_r\psi_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial D_k}.

用反向模式的横线记号：以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi 为种子运行反向扫描，得到 𝐮ˉ=ATψ=−g\bar{\mathbf u}=A^T\psi=-g，这就是伴随方程；设计伴随 Dˉ=∇DJ+RDTψ\bar D=\nabla_DJ+R_D^T\psi 就是梯度 ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J。也可以直接检查与 tangent 的等价性：利用 Av=−RD D˙Av=-R_D\,\dot D，gTv=−ψTAv=ψTRD D˙g^Tv=-\psi^TAv=\psi^TR_D\,\dot D，所以两条路线给出同一个 J˙=DˉTD˙\dot J=\bar D^T\dot D。更换为 ℒ=J−λTR\mathcal L=J-\lambda^TR 会得到 λ=−ψ\lambda=-\psi，但这只是两个离散乘子的符号约定，不能据此认定连续场 λ(x)\lambda(x) 与离散向量逐点相等。

In the bar notation of reverse mode: the reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi returns 𝐮ˉ=ATψ=−g\bar{\mathbf u}=A^T\psi=-g, which is the adjoint equation, and the design adjoint Dˉ=∇DJ+RDTψ\bar D=\nabla_DJ+R_D^T\psi is the gradient ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J. Check equivalence with the tangent: Av=−RD D˙Av=-R_D\,\dot D gives gTv=−ψTAv=ψTRD D˙g^Tv=-\psi^TAv=\psi^TR_D\,\dot D, so both routes give the same J˙=DˉTD˙\dot J=\bar D^T\dot D. Changing to ℒ=J−λTR\mathcal L=J-\lambda^TR yields λ=−ψ\lambda=-\psi, but that relates two discrete sign conventions; it does not prove pointwise equality with a continuous field λ(x)\lambda(x).

精确算子决定求解哪个方程；GS 固定点、GS 预处理 GMRES 与 LU（附录 C）决定如何求解。较便宜的近似 Jacobian（例如一阶或冻结部分系数的 Jacobian）可以用于迭代修正或预处理，但不能替代精确转置。应监控真残差 rψ=ATψ+gr_\psi=A^T\psi+g。若其不为零，当前伴随与精确 tangent 的方向导数差为 −rψTv-r_\psi^Tv，因此只看迭代次数或预处理残差不够。

The exact operator determines the equation; the GS fixed point, GS-preconditioned GMRES and LU (Appendix C) determine how it is solved. A cheaper approximate Jacobian (first order, or with some coefficients frozen) may supply corrections or preconditioning, but cannot replace the exact transpose. Monitor the true residual rψ=ATψ+gr_\psi=A^T\psi+g. If it is nonzero, the current adjoint directional derivative minus the exact tangent derivative is −rψTv-r_\psi^Tv; an iteration count or a preconditioned residual alone is insufficient.

第 12 节Section 12

设计导数与反问题

Design derivatives and inverse design

一次伴随求解之后，每个导数只是内积

After one adjoint solve, each derivative is an inner product

前向模式要把设计种子依次取为单位向量 D˙=ek\dot D=e_k，才得到梯度的各个分量；反向模式一次给出全部分量 Dˉ\bar D。本例源项导数非常稀疏：格心一个源区间影响一个控制体；格点一个源区间影响左右两个半控制体，但入口约束行不保留源项。伴随把这些局部直接影响与全局目标权重配对。

Forward mode needs the design seed D˙=ek\dot D=e_k for each kk in turn to obtain the gradient components; reverse mode gives all of them, Dˉ\bar D, at once. Source derivatives are sparse: one cell interval affects one volume; one node-based interval affects two half-volumes, with the inlet constraint row excluding its source contribution. The adjoint pairs these local direct effects with global objective weights.

∂Ri∂σk=−hδik⟹dJdσk=−hψk.\frac{\partial R_i}{\partial\sigma_k}=-h\delta_{ik}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\frac{dJ}{d\sigma_k}=-h\psi_k.

负梯度给出目标局部下降方向，但大步长可能越过线性近似有效的范围。演示中的 BFGS 利用历史梯度差构造逆 Hessian 近似，再用回溯缩短步长，直到目标充分下降。每个候选设计都需要重新解原始方程；伴随提供的是该设计处的梯度。
