附录 B：间断、激波位移与离散伴随

Appendix B: discontinuities, shock motion and discrete adjoints

正文先在光滑解上学习离散伴随。本附录进一步问：解出现间断后，怎样构造守恒求解程序，又怎样对这个程序求导？我们使用独立的无源、非定常 Riemann 问题。两种页面在这里都采用同一个单元平均有限体积实现；格点页的正文离散并没有被悄悄替换。附录控制独立于页顶的稳态 GS／GMRES 控制。

The main chapters introduce discrete adjoints using smooth solutions. Here we ask how to build and differentiate a conservative solver when discontinuities occur. This independent experiment solves a source-free, unsteady Riemann problem. Both pages use the same cell-average finite-volume implementation in this appendix; the node-centred discretisation in the main text is unchanged. These controls are independent of the steady GS/GMRES controls above.

B.1 从强形式到熵解：为什么不能直接跨过间断求导

B.1 From the strong form to entropy solutions

ut+f(u)x=0,f(u)=u2/2,u(x,0;a)={uL,x<a,uR,x>a.u_t+f(u)_x=0,\quad f(u)=u^2/2,\qquad u(x,0;a)=\begin{cases}u_L,&x<a,\\u_R,&x>a.\end{cases}

在跳跃处，普通意义的空间导数不存在。对一个小控制体积分，再让它包围的激波宽度趋于零，左右通量差必须等于跳跃随界面移动带来的质量变化。因此得到 Rankine–Hugoniot 条件。它给出移动速度，却不能单独选出物理解。Burgers 的熵条件要求压缩激波两侧特征线进入激波；若左值小于右值，物理解是连续展开的稀疏波，而不是满足相同守恒条件的“膨胀激波”。

Ordinary spatial derivatives do not exist at a jump. Integrate over a small control volume enclosing the moving shock: the flux difference must balance the mass change caused by its motion. This gives the Rankine–Hugoniot condition. Conservation determines a speed but does not select the physical solution. Characteristics enter an admissible compressive Burgers shock; increasing Riemann data instead generate a continuous rarefaction, not an expansion shock.

s=f(uL)−f(uR)uL−uR=uL+uR2,xs(t)=a+st,uL>s>uR.s=\frac{f(u_L)-f(u_R)}{u_L-u_R}=\frac{u_L+u_R}{2},\quad x_s(t)=a+st,\quad u_L>s>u_R.
uL<uR:u(x,t)={uL,(x−a)/t<uL,(x−a)/t,uL≤(x−a)/t≤uR,uR,(x−a)/t>uR.u_L<u_R:\quad u(x,t)=\begin{cases}u_L,&(x-a)/t<u_L,\\(x-a)/t,&u_L\le (x-a)/t\le u_R,\\u_R,&(x-a)/t>u_R.\end{cases}

可对照 Clawpack 的 Burgers Riemann 问题。下方包括移动激波 (1,0)、驻定激波 (1,−1) 和稀疏波 (−0.5,0.5)。时间和位置范围保证解析波不碰到边界；左右边界分别以给定的常值外侧状态计算通量。

See the Clawpack Burgers Riemann chapter. The experiment includes a moving shock (1,0), a stationary shock (1,−1), and a rarefaction (−0.5,0.5). The permitted time and position ranges keep the exact waves away from boundaries. Boundary fluxes use the prescribed constant exterior states.

逐步推导：Rankine–Hugoniot 条件

Step by step: the Rankine–Hugoniot condition

守恒律的积分形式对任何控制体都成立，不需要 uu 可微：

The integral form of the conservation law holds for any control volume and does not need uu to be differentiable:

ddt∫x1x2u dx=f(u(x1,t))−f(u(x2,t)).\frac{d}{dt}\int_{x_1}^{x_2}u\,dx=f(u(x_1,t))-f(u(x_2,t)).

取 x1<xs(t)<x2x_1<x_s(t)<x_2，两侧分别是常值 uLu_L、uRu_R。积分等于两段长度乘各自的值，只有激波位置随时间变化：

Take x1<xs(t)<x2x_1<x_s(t)<x_2 with constant states uLu_L and uRu_R on the two sides. The integral is the two lengths times their values, and only the shock position depends on time:

∫x1x2u dx=(xs−x1)uL+(x2−xs)uR⟹ddt∫x1x2u dx=dxsdt (uL−uR).\begin{aligned}\int_{x_1}^{x_2}u\,dx&=(x_s-x_1)u_L+(x_2-x_s)u_R\\\Longrightarrow\quad\frac{d}{dt}\int_{x_1}^{x_2}u\,dx&=\frac{dx_s}{dt}\,(u_L-u_R).\end{aligned}

令两式相等，得到激波速度；对 f=u2/2f=u^2/2，分子可以分解，速度就是两侧状态的平均：

Equating the two expressions gives the shock speed; for f=u2/2f=u^2/2 the numerator factorises and the speed is the mean of the two states:

s=dxsdt=f(uL)−f(uR)uL−uR=(uL−uR)(uL+uR)/2uL−uR=uL+uR2.s=\frac{dx_s}{dt}=\frac{f(u_L)-f(u_R)}{u_L-u_R}=\frac{(u_L-u_R)(u_L+u_R)/2}{u_L-u_R}=\frac{u_L+u_R}{2}.

熵条件看特征速度 f′(u)=uf'(u)=u：两侧特征线都要进入激波，即 uL>s>uRu_L>s>u_R。代入 s=(uL+uR)/2s=(u_L+u_R)/2，它等价于 uL>uRu_L>u_R。若 uL<uRu_L<u_R，同样满足守恒的“膨胀激波”两侧特征线离开激波，不是物理解，物理解是下图 (c) 的稀疏波扇区。

The entropy condition concerns the characteristic speed f′(u)=uf'(u)=u: characteristics from both sides must enter the shock, uL>s>uRu_L>s>u_R. With s=(uL+uR)/2s=(u_L+u_R)/2 this is equivalent to uL>uRu_L>u_R. For uL<uRu_L<u_R an "expansion shock" would conserve mass but its characteristics leave it; the physical solution is the rarefaction fan of panel (c) below.

B.2 网格、初值投影与限幅重构

B.2 Mesh, initial projection and limited reconstruction

未知量是每个单元的平均值 uᵢ，初始时刻记作 uᵢ⁰。若初始跳跃切过一个单元，就按左右部分长度加权，不能简单按单元中心的位置赋值，否则小幅改变 a 时整个离散初值不变，计算出的导数会错误地归零。下面 θ 是左状态在该单元所占的比例。

The unknowns are the cell averages uᵢ, written uᵢ⁰ at the initial time. A cell cut by the initial jump receives a length-weighted average. Sampling the state only at the cell centre would make sufficiently small changes in a invisible, giving a misleading zero derivative. Here θ is the fraction occupied by the left state.

ui0=uR+(uL−uR)θi,θi=clip⁡ ⁣(a−xi−1/2h,0,1),∂ui0∂a={(uL−uR)/h,a∈(xi−1/2,xi+1/2),0,otherwise.u_i^0=u_R+(u_L-u_R)\theta_i,\quad\theta_i=\operatorname{clip}\!\left(\frac{a-x_{i-1/2}}h,0,1\right),\quad \frac{\partial u_i^0}{\partial a}=\begin{cases}(u_L-u_R)/h,&a\in(x_{i-1/2},x_{i+1/2}),\\0,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases}

当 a 正好在网格面上，上式不再给出唯一的双侧导数：a 向左或向右移动时变化的是不同单元。实现选取右侧方向作为初始 tangent，界面会明确提示，并同时列出单侧差分。离散初值的向量导数随网格加密变得更尖，并不应期待它逐点收敛为普通函数。

At a mesh face there is no unique two-sided derivative of this projection: moving a to the left or to the right changes different cells. The implementation selects the right-side initial direction, displays a warning, and reports both one-sided differences. The initial tangent becomes more concentrated on refinement; pointwise convergence to an ordinary function is not expected.

di=minmod⁡(ui−ui−1,ui+1−ui),ui+1/2−=ui+12di,ui+1/2+=ui+1−12di+1.d_i=\operatorname{minmod}(u_i-u_{i-1},u_{i+1}-u_i),\quad u^-_{i+1/2}=u_i+\tfrac12d_i,\quad u^+_{i+1/2}=u_{i+1}-\tfrac12d_{i+1}.

一阶令 d=0。限幅模式在两侧差分异号或有零时令 d=0，否则取绝对值较小的差分；相等时选左差分。首末单元不重构。它在光滑、非极值区域允许二阶重构，在间断附近自动降低精度；不能把“二阶模式”理解成含激波解在所有范数下都有二阶收敛。下面的图保留每个网格面和每个单元平均值，选中单元还能查看具体限幅运算。

First order sets d=0. The limited mode chooses zero for opposite signs or a zero difference; otherwise it selects the smaller magnitude, choosing the left difference at a tie. Endpoint cells are not reconstructed. Second-order reconstruction is possible in smooth non-extremal regions, while accuracy is reduced near a discontinuity. This does not imply second-order convergence in every norm for solutions with shocks. The plot shows every mesh face and cell average; selecting a cell exposes its limiter calculation.

逐步推导：切割单元的初值导数

Step by step: the derivative of the cut-cell average

设跳跃 aa 落在第 ii 个单元 (xi−1/2,xi+1/2)(x_{i-1/2},x_{i+1/2}) 内。单元平均把两段分开积分：

Let the jump aa lie in cell ii, (xi−1/2,xi+1/2)(x_{i-1/2},x_{i+1/2}). The cell average integrates the two pieces separately:

ui0=1h[∫xi−1/2auL dx+∫axi+1/2uR dx]=uR+(uL−uR)a−xi−1/2h,∂ui0∂a=uL−uRh.\begin{gathered}u_i^0=\frac1h\Bigl[\int_{x_{i-1/2}}^{a}u_L\,dx+\int_a^{x_{i+1/2}}u_R\,dx\Bigr]=u_R+(u_L-u_R)\frac{a-x_{i-1/2}}h,\\\frac{\partial u_i^0}{\partial a}=\frac{u_L-u_R}h.\end{gathered}

其他单元不含 aa，导数为零。于是 h∑i∂ui0/∂a=uL−uRh\sum_i\partial u_i^0/\partial a=u_L-u_R：离散导数是一个高 (uL−uR)/h(u_L-u_R)/h、宽 hh 的尖峰，总质量与连续导数 [u]δ(x−a)[u]\delta(x-a) 相同。

No other cell contains aa, so their derivatives vanish. Hence h∑i∂ui0/∂a=uL−uRh\sum_i\partial u_i^0/\partial a=u_L-u_R: the discrete derivative is a spike of height (uL−uR)/h(u_L-u_R)/h and width hh whose total mass equals that of the continuous derivative [u]δ(x−a)[u]\delta(x-a).

B.3 守恒通量与实际时间推进

B.3 Conservative flux and implemented time integration

H(u−,u+)=14((u−)2+(u+)2)−α2(u+−u−),α=1.2,ℒi(u)=−Hi+1/2−Hi−1/2h.H(u^-,u^+)=\tfrac14\bigl((u^-)^2+(u^+)^2\bigr)-\tfrac\alpha2(u^+-u^-),\quad \alpha=1.2,\qquad \mathcal L_i(u)=-\frac{H_{i+1/2}-H_{i-1/2}}h.

这是局部 Lax–Friedrichs 形式的数值通量（和正文一样记作 H，两侧迹记作 u⁻、u⁺），本实验把波速上界 α 固定为 1.2，而非每一步计算 max|u|。给定算例的状态范围不超过 1，因此这个选择覆盖波速，也避免把 max／绝对值的分支变化混入求导。每个内部面只计算一次通量，并以相反符号进入相邻单元；所以质量变化精确等于边界净通量，只有舍入误差。

This Lax–Friedrichs-form flux (written H as in the main text, with traces u⁻ and u⁺) uses a fixed wave-speed bound α=1.2 rather than recomputing max|u|. The supplied states have magnitude at most one, so this covers their wave speeds and avoids differentiating another max/absolute-value branch. Each internal face contributes with opposite signs to adjacent cells, making mass change equal the net boundary flux up to roundoff.

yn=un+Δt ℒ(un),un+1=12un+12(yn+Δt ℒ(yn)),αΔt/h≤0.35.y^n=u^n+\Delta t\,\mathcal L(u^n),\qquad u^{n+1}=\tfrac12u^n+\tfrac12\bigl(y^n+\Delta t\,\mathcal L(y^n)\bigr),\qquad \alpha\Delta t/h\le0.35.

使用两级 SSP-RK2；步数取整后重新设置 Δt，恰好到达终止时间 T。改变设计参数 a 不改变步数、Δt、网格或 α。这样比较的是同一个离散程序。这里是显式非定常算法，没有需要 GS 求解的稳态线性方程；若改为隐式推进，每个时间层仍可用正文的 GS／预处理 GMRES 求解，但还必须把所有时间层的依赖反向传播，不能只求一个最终稳态伴随。

The implementation uses two-stage SSP-RK2. An integer number of steps is chosen and Δt adjusted to reach T exactly. Changing a leaves the mesh, time schedule and α unchanged, so comparisons differentiate the same discrete program. This explicit transient algorithm has no steady linear system to solve with GS. An implicit version could use GS/preconditioned GMRES at each time level, but its adjoint must still reverse dependencies through all time levels.

这里 N 表示单元数，K 表示时间步数；本附录的 dᵢ 是单元内增量（等于斜率乘 h），与正文按长度求导的斜率符号不同。以下示意图标出两条必须同时保留的 RK 依赖路径。

Here N counts cells and K counts time steps. The appendix uses dᵢ for an increment (slope times h), unlike the spatial derivative used for slopes in the main text. The diagram shows both RK dependency paths that must be retained.

B.4 Matrix-free tangent：求导到每个选中的分支

B.4 Matrix-free tangent through each selected branch

H˙=(u−2+α2)u˙−+(u+2−α2)u˙+,ℒ˙i=(H˙i−1/2−H˙i+1/2)/h.\dot H=\Bigl(\frac{u^-}2+\frac\alpha2\Bigr)\dot u^-+\Bigl(\frac{u^+}2-\frac\alpha2\Bigr)\dot u^+,\quad \dot{\mathcal L}_i=(\dot H_{i-1/2}-\dot H_{i+1/2})/h.

先保存每个 RK 子阶段选中的 minmod 分支。左分支给出 d˙i=u˙i−u˙i−1\dot d_i=\dot u_i-\dot u_{i-1}，右分支给出 d˙i=u˙i+1−u˙i\dot d_i=\dot u_{i+1}-\dot u_i，零分支给出 d˙i=0\dot d_i=0。再求左右重构值、面通量和单元残差的切向量。这是局部运算得到的 ℒ˙=ℒ′(u) u˙\dot{\mathcal L}=\mathcal L'(u)\,\dot u，不组装全局矩阵。注意：保存分支仍要对该分支里的差分求导；把整个限幅斜率当常数冻结通常不是原离散程序的导数。

Save the selected minmod branch at each RK stage. Its slope tangent is d˙i=u˙i−u˙i−1\dot d_i=\dot u_i-\dot u_{i-1} for the left branch, d˙i=u˙i+1−u˙i\dot d_i=\dot u_{i+1}-\dot u_i for the right branch, and d˙i=0\dot d_i=0 for the zero branch. Carry the tangents through the reconstructed traces, face fluxes and residual scatter. These local operations evaluate ℒ˙=ℒ′(u) u˙\dot{\mathcal L}=\mathcal L'(u)\,\dot u without a global matrix. Saving a branch still requires differentiating the difference inside it; freezing the whole limited slope generally differentiates a different program.

u˙0=∂au0 a˙  (a˙=1),y˙n=u˙n+Δt Anu˙n,u˙n+1=12u˙n+12(y˙n+Δt Bny˙n),An=ℒ′(un), Bn=ℒ′(yn).\dot u^0=\partial_a u^0\,\dot a\ \ (\dot a=1),\quad \dot y^n=\dot u^n+\Delta t\,A_n\dot u^n,\quad \dot u^{n+1}=\tfrac12\dot u^n+\tfrac12(\dot y^n+\Delta t\,B_n\dot y^n),\quad A_n=\mathcal L^{\prime}(u^n),\ B_n=\mathcal L^{\prime}(y^n).

在 minmod 的零点或等幅交界处，所保存的是一个选定分支的线性映射，不保证存在对所有方向都适用的经典导数。即使 tangent 与 adjoint 的点积完全相等，也只证明两段代码互为转置；还需要比较单侧差分、分支切换以及步长变化。不能直接把正文的复数步长算法套到比较运算和 minmod 上。

At zero or equal-magnitude limiter boundaries, the saved map is a selected-branch linearisation, not necessarily a classical derivative valid for every direction. A perfect tangent/adjoint dot test only establishes transposition of those maps. One-sided differences, branch changes and step-size dependence still matter. The complex-step procedure in the main text cannot be applied blindly through comparisons and minmod.

B.5 反向时间 adjoint：转置面循环和 RK 计算图

B.5 Reverse-time adjoint: face loops and the RK graph

Jh=h∑iq(xi)G(uiK),q(x)=1+x,G(u)=u or u2/2,uˉiK=∂Jh∂uiK=hq(xi)G′(uiK).J_h=h\sum_iq(x_i)G(u_i^K),\quad q(x)=1+x,\quad G(u)=u\ \text{or}\ u^2/2,\qquad \bar u_i^K=\frac{\partial J_h}{\partial u_i^K}=hq(x_i)G^{\prime}(u_i^K).

对一个面，从空间算子的种子 ℒˉ=w\bar{\mathcal L}=w 出发，面通量的伴随是 Hˉi+1/2=(wi+1−wi)/h\bar H_{i+1/2}=(w_{i+1}-w_i)/h；边界外侧种子为零。乘以通量对 u−u^-、u+u^+ 的偏导，累加到两侧单元的伴随，并把 ±12\pm\tfrac12 的贡献传给斜率的伴随 dˉ\bar d。最后按照保存的 minmod 分支，把 dˉ\bar d 加到对应的两个单元。这直接计算 ℒ′(u)Tw\mathcal L'(u)^Tw。随后的 RK 反传必须同时保留 unu^n 到最终平均值的直接路径与经过 yny^n 的路径。

For each face, start from the seed ℒˉ=w\bar{\mathcal L}=w of the spatial operator: the face-flux adjoint is Hˉi+1/2=(wi+1−wi)/h\bar H_{i+1/2}=(w_{i+1}-w_i)/h, with zero exterior seeds. Multiply by the flux derivatives with respect to u−u^- and u+u^+, accumulate into the adjoints of the two adjacent cells, and pass the ±12\pm\tfrac12 contributions to the slope adjoints dˉ\bar d. Reverse the saved slope branch into its two cells. This evaluates ℒ′(u)Tw\mathcal L'(u)^Tw directly. Reversing RK must include both the direct averaging path from unu^n and the path through yny^n.

yˉn=12(I+ΔtBnT)uˉn+1,uˉn=12uˉn+1+(I+ΔtAnT)yˉn,dJhda=(uˉ0)T∂au0=(uˉK)Tu˙K.\bar y^n=\tfrac12(I+\Delta t B_n^T)\bar u^{n+1},\qquad \bar u^n=\tfrac12\bar u^{n+1}+(I+\Delta t A_n^T)\bar y^n,\qquad \frac{dJ_h}{da}=(\bar u^0)^T\partial_a u^0=(\bar u^K)^T\dot u^K.

本实验存储每个时间层和两级重构分支，内存随“单元数×时间步数”增长。工业非定常伴随通常需要检查点和重算。图中画的是 ū/h，便于与连续伴随场比较；真正用于点积的是含 h 的 ū，不能再额外乘一次 h。

This experiment stores states and both reconstruction stages, using memory proportional to cells times steps. Large unsteady adjoints usually need checkpointing and recomputation. The plot displays ū/h for comparison with a continuous adjoint density; dot products use ū itself, which already contains h.

u = exact_cell_average(step(a))
for n = 0,...,K-1:
    A = stage(u)                  # flux + saved limiter branch
    y = u + dt*A.L
    B = stage(y)
    u = (u + y + dt*B.L)/2
    save(A, B)
u_b = h*q*Gprime(u)               # u_b = ū^K: the seed dJ_h/du^K
for n = K-1,...,0:                # reverse order: the adjoint of y first
    y_b = (u_b + dt*vjp(B[n],u_b))/2
    u_b = u_b/2 + y_b + dt*vjp(A[n],y_b)
gradient = dot(u_b, initial_direction(a))

逐步推导：一个面的反向传播

Step by step: reversing one face

前向计算中，内部面 i+12i+\tfrac12 的通量 Hi+1/2H_{i+1/2} 只进入两个单元的 ℒ\mathcal L。以 ℒˉ=w\bar{\mathcal L}=w 为种子，它的伴随收集这两条路径：

In the forward computation, the flux Hi+1/2H_{i+1/2} of the interior face i+12i+\tfrac12 enters ℒ\mathcal L of only two cells. With the seed ℒˉ=w\bar{\mathcal L}=w, its adjoint collects these two paths:

ℒi=⋯−Hi+1/2h,ℒi+1=Hi+1/2h+⋯⟹Hˉi+1/2=∑kwk∂ℒk∂Hi+1/2=wi+1−wih.\begin{gathered}\mathcal L_i=\cdots-\frac{H_{i+1/2}}h,\qquad \mathcal L_{i+1}=\frac{H_{i+1/2}}h+\cdots\\\Longrightarrow\quad \bar H_{i+1/2}=\sum_kw_k\frac{\partial\mathcal L_k}{\partial H_{i+1/2}}=\frac{w_{i+1}-w_i}h.\end{gathered}

再乘以通量对两侧迹的偏导，然后按重构 u−=ui+12diu^-=u_i+\tfrac12d_i、u+=ui+1−12di+1u^+=u_{i+1}-\tfrac12d_{i+1} 的转置累加（反向语句按与前向相反的顺序执行）：

Multiply by the flux derivatives with respect to the two traces, then accumulate through the transposed reconstruction u−=ui+12diu^-=u_i+\tfrac12d_i, u+=ui+1−12di+1u^+=u_{i+1}-\tfrac12d_{i+1} (the reverse statements run in the opposite order of the forward ones):

uˉ−=Hˉi+1/2(u−2+α2),uˉ+=Hˉi+1/2(u+2−α2);uˉi+=uˉ−,  dˉi+=12uˉ−,uˉi+1+=uˉ+,  dˉi+1-=12uˉ+.\begin{gathered}\bar u^-=\bar H_{i+1/2}\Bigl(\frac{u^-}2+\frac\alpha2\Bigr),\qquad \bar u^+=\bar H_{i+1/2}\Bigl(\frac{u^+}2-\frac\alpha2\Bigr);\\\bar u_i\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar u^-,\ \ \bar d_i\mathrel{\text{+=}}\tfrac12\bar u^-,\qquad \bar u_{i+1}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar u^+,\ \ \bar d_{i+1}\mathrel{\text{-=}}\tfrac12\bar u^+.\end{gathered}

最后把每个 dˉi\bar d_i 按保存的分支送回两个单元：左分支 di=ui−ui−1d_i=u_i-u_{i-1} 给出 uˉi+=dˉi\bar u_i\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar d_i、uˉi−1-=dˉi\bar u_{i-1}\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar d_i；右分支类推；零分支什么也不做。边界面的外侧状态是常数，没有对应的伴随。

Finally send each dˉi\bar d_i back to two cells through the saved branch: the left branch di=ui−ui−1d_i=u_i-u_{i-1} gives uˉi+=dˉi\bar u_i\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar d_i and uˉi−1-=dˉi\bar u_{i-1}\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar d_i; the right branch is analogous; the zero branch does nothing. Exterior states at boundary faces are constants and have no adjoint.

逐步推导：SSP-RK2 的反向与点积守恒

Step by step: reversing SSP-RK2 and the conserved dot product

一步 SSP-RK2 的 tangent 是两个线性映射的组合：

The tangent of one SSP-RK2 step combines two linear maps:

y˙n=(I+ΔtAn)u˙n,u˙n+1=12u˙n+12(I+ΔtBn)y˙n.\dot y^n=(I+\Delta tA_n)\dot u^n,\qquad \dot u^{n+1}=\tfrac12\dot u^n+\tfrac12(I+\Delta tB_n)\dot y^n.

反向时，横线量是目标对该中间量的导数（伴随），语句按相反顺序执行：先算 yˉn\bar y^n，再算 uˉn\bar u^n。yny^n 只通过第二式影响 un+1u^{n+1}；unu^n 既直接进入 un+1u^{n+1}，又通过 yny^n 进入，所以两条路径相加：

In reverse, a barred quantity is the derivative of the objective with respect to an intermediate quantity (its adjoint), and the statements run in the opposite order: first yˉn\bar y^n, then uˉn\bar u^n. yny^n affects un+1u^{n+1} only through the second map; unu^n enters un+1u^{n+1} both directly and through yny^n, so the two paths add:

yˉn=(∂un+1∂yn)Tuˉn+1=12(I+ΔtBnT)uˉn+1,uˉn=12uˉn+1+(I+ΔtAnT)yˉn.\bar y^n=\Bigl(\frac{\partial u^{n+1}}{\partial y^n}\Bigr)^T\bar u^{n+1}=\tfrac12(I+\Delta tB_n^T)\bar u^{n+1},\qquad \bar u^n=\tfrac12\bar u^{n+1}+(I+\Delta tA_n^T)\bar y^n.

用这两式可以直接证明每一步的点积不变（AD 的对偶恒等式），于是 (uˉ0)Tu˙0=(uˉK)Tu˙K(\bar u^0)^T\dot u^0=(\bar u^K)^T\dot u^K，即 adjoint 与 tangent 给出同一个 dJh/dadJ_h/da：

These two formulas prove directly that each step preserves the dot product (the duality identity of AD), so (uˉ0)Tu˙0=(uˉK)Tu˙K(\bar u^0)^T\dot u^0=(\bar u^K)^T\dot u^K: the adjoint and the tangent give the same dJh/dadJ_h/da:

(uˉn+1)Tu˙n+1=12(uˉn+1)Tu˙n+12((I+ΔtBnT)uˉn+1)T⏟(yˉn)T(I+ΔtAn)u˙n=(12uˉn+1+(I+ΔtAnT)yˉn)Tu˙n=(uˉn)Tu˙n.\begin{aligned}(\bar u^{n+1})^T\dot u^{n+1}&=\tfrac12(\bar u^{n+1})^T\dot u^n+\underbrace{\tfrac12\bigl((I+\Delta tB_n^T)\bar u^{n+1}\bigr)^T}_{(\bar y^n)^T}(I+\Delta tA_n)\dot u^n\\&=\bigl(\tfrac12\bar u^{n+1}+(I+\Delta tA_n^T)\bar y^n\bigr)^T\dot u^n=(\bar u^n)^T\dot u^n.\end{aligned}

B.6 激波位移导数与连续伴随的适定性

B.6 Shock displacement and continuous-adjoint well-posedness

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

激波位置导数、Dirac 分布及移动界面目标项属于已有理论；本节的研究性部分是当前固定耗散／minmod 离散是否逼近这些参考，特别是驻定激波二次目标的非零离散梯度和伴随平台误差。已有特定格式的收敛理论不能直接套用。本节及 B.7 的有限网格数据是观察，不是当前格式的一般收敛证明。

Shock-position derivatives, Dirac distributions and moving-interface objective terms are established theory. The research-oriented part is whether this fixed-dissipation/minmod discretization approaches those references, particularly the nonzero discrete gradient for a stationary shock with a quadratic objective and adjoint-plateau errors. Existing convergence theory for particular schemes does not automatically apply. The finite-grid data here and in B.7 are observations, not a general convergence proof for this scheme.

改变初始位置 a 会移动激波。把解写成两个常值和 Heaviside 阶跃，就会得到 Dirac 分布，而不是一个有界的普通 tangent 场。目标函数仍可有有限导数：应先对移动界面的积分求导，不能在激波处随意代入一个 G′(u)。以下方括号表示左值减右值。

Changing a moves the shock. Differentiating the Heaviside representation gives a Dirac distribution rather than a bounded tangent field. An integral objective can nevertheless have a finite derivative: differentiate the moving-interface integral instead of assigning an arbitrary G′(u) at the jump. Brackets below denote left minus right.

J(a)=G(uL)∫0a+sTq(x) dx+G(uR)∫a+sT1q(x) dx,∂axs=1.J(a)=G(u_L)\int_0^{a+sT}q(x)\,dx+G(u_R)\int_{a+sT}^1q(x)\,dx,\qquad \partial_a x_s=1.
∂au=[u]δ(x−xs),J=∫01q(x)G(u(x,T)) dx,dJda=q(xs)[G].\partial_a u=[u]\delta(x-x_s),\qquad J=\int_0^1q(x)G(u(x,T))\,dx,\qquad \frac{dJ}{da}=q(x_s)[G].

这个推导也解释了为何不能写成 G′(u(xₛ))·[u]：间断点的 u 没有唯一值，非线性 G 的跳跃是 [G]。对二次目标，[G]/[u]=(uLu_L+uRu_R)/2=s。若忽略激波位移，即使两侧光滑区的线性化都正确，也会漏掉整个位置导数。

This derivation explains why G′(u(xₛ))·[u] is not a valid replacement: u has no unique value at the jump, and the nonlinear jump is [G]. For a quadratic objective, [G]/[u]=(uLu_L+uRu_R)/2=s. Ignoring shock motion loses the entire position derivative even when both smooth-side linearisations are correct.

在两侧光滑区域形式上有 −λₜ−uλₓ=0，终端值为 qG′。但这不足以定义跨激波的伴随：必须包含界面移动的贡献。对此常值 Riemann 激波，把进入激波的初始特征线区域识别出来，得到下面的初始伴随平台。它满足 λ(a,0)·[u]=q(xₛ)[G]，从而恢复位置导数。交互在初始时刻画出这个解析参考；稀疏波没有激波平台，不画此参考。

In smooth regions the formal adjoint is −λₜ−uλₓ=0 with terminal data qG′. These equations alone do not define an adjoint across the shock: interface motion must be included. For this constant-state Riemann shock, identifying initial characteristics captured by the shock gives the plateau below. Its value times [u] recovers q(xₛ)[G]. The interaction overlays this analytic reference at the initial time; no shock plateau is drawn for a rarefaction.

λ(x,0)={q(x+uLT)G′(uL),x<a+(s−uL)T,q(xs)[G]/[u],a+(s−uL)T<x<a+(s−uR)T,q(x+uRT)G′(uR),x>a+(s−uR)T.\lambda(x,0)=\begin{cases}q(x+u_LT)G^{\prime}(u_L),&x<a+(s-u_L)T,\\q(x_s)[G]/[u],&a+(s-u_L)T<x<a+(s-u_R)T,\\q(x+u_RT)G^{\prime}(u_R),&x>a+(s-u_R)T.\end{cases}

稀疏波可直接在扇区内求导：dJ/da=−∫扇区 q(x)G′((x−a)/T)/T dx，边缘因状态连续而没有额外跳跃项。驻定激波 (1,−1) 的二次目标有 [G]=0，所以连续位置导数恰为零；数值上涂抹的激波可能产生非零的位置灵敏度。这里的差异是需要研究的结果，不能通过修改解析答案来“对齐”。

For a rarefaction, dJ/da=−∫fan q(x)G′((x−a)/T)/T dx; continuity at fan edges eliminates jump contributions. For the stationary (1,−1) shock and quadratic objective, [G]=0 and the continuous position derivative is exactly zero. A numerically smeared shock may produce nonzero position sensitivity. Such discrepancies are a result to investigate, not a reason to adjust the analytic reference.

逐步推导：移动界面的求导（Leibniz 公式）

Step by step: differentiating a moving interface (Leibniz rule)

激波情形的目标由两段常值积分组成，积分上下限随 aa 移动。对积分限求导（Leibniz 公式），被积函数本身与 aa 无关：

For a shock the objective consists of two integrals of constants whose limits move with aa. Differentiating the limits (Leibniz rule), with integrands independent of aa:

dJda=G(uL)q(xs)∂xs∂a−G(uR)q(xs)∂xs∂a=q(xs)[G(uL)−G(uR)],∂xs∂a=1.\frac{dJ}{da}=G(u_L)q(x_s)\frac{\partial x_s}{\partial a}-G(u_R)q(x_s)\frac{\partial x_s}{\partial a}=q(x_s)\bigl[G(u_L)-G(u_R)\bigr],\qquad \frac{\partial x_s}{\partial a}=1.

本页默认 a=0.371a=0.371、T=0.15T=0.15：移动激波的 xs=a+sT=0.446x_s=a+sT=0.446，G=uG=u 时 dJ/da=1.446dJ/da=1.446，G=u2/2G=u^2/2 时为 0.7230.723；驻定激波 xs=ax_s=a，[G][G] 分别为 2 与 0，得到 2.7422.742 与 0。

With this page's defaults a=0.371a=0.371, T=0.15T=0.15 the moving shock has xs=a+sT=0.446x_s=a+sT=0.446, giving dJ/da=1.446dJ/da=1.446 for G=uG=u and 0.7230.723 for G=u2/2G=u^2/2; the stationary shock has xs=ax_s=a and [G][G] equal to 2 and 0, giving 2.7422.742 and 0.

逐步推导：伴随平台来自质量守恒

Step by step: the adjoint plateau from mass conservation

伴随值就是目标对初值局部扰动的灵敏度。在初始时刻 x0x_0 处加一小块质量 ϵ\epsilon，即 δu(x,0)=ϵ δ(x−x0)\delta u(x,0)=\epsilon\,\delta(x-x_0)。它沿特征线 dx/dt=udx/dt=u 平移。若在 TT 之前没有碰到激波，终端的目标变化是 ϵ q(x0+uT)G′(u)\epsilon\,q(x_0+uT)G'(u)，这就是平台两侧的值。若它先进入激波，扰动被激波吸收，两侧状态恢复为 uLu_L、uRu_R，多出的质量只能表现为激波位置的移动：

An adjoint value is the sensitivity of the objective to a local change of the initial data. Add a small mass ϵ\epsilon at x0x_0 at the initial time, δu(x,0)=ϵ δ(x−x0)\delta u(x,0)=\epsilon\,\delta(x-x_0). It travels along the characteristic dx/dt=udx/dt=u. If it does not meet the shock before TT, the terminal change of the objective is ϵ q(x0+uT)G′(u)\epsilon\,q(x_0+uT)G'(u): these are the values on the two sides of the plateau. If it enters the shock first, the shock absorbs it, both states return to uLu_L and uRu_R, and the extra mass can only appear as a shift of the shock:

(uL−uR) δxs=ϵ⟹δJ=q(xs)[G] δxs=q(xs)[G][u] ϵ⟹λ(x0,0)=q(xs)[G][u].\begin{gathered}(u_L-u_R)\,\delta x_s=\epsilon\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \delta J=q(x_s)[G]\,\delta x_s=\frac{q(x_s)[G]}{[u]}\,\epsilon\\\Longrightarrow\quad \lambda(x_0,0)=\frac{q(x_s)[G]}{[u]}.\end{gathered}

这个值与 x0x_0 无关，只要 x0x_0 的特征线在 TT 之前进入激波。左侧特征线 x0+uLtx_0+u_Lt 在 t=Tt=T 恰好到达激波的起点是 x0=a+(s−uL)T=0.296x_0=a+(s-u_L)T=0.296，右侧是 a+(s−uR)T=0.446a+(s-u_R)T=0.446，两者之间就是平台。G=uG=u 时平台与两侧连续（值 1.446）；G=u2/2G=u^2/2 时平台值 0.723，两侧分别是 q(x+T)q(x+T) 与 0，出现两个跳跃。平台值乘 [u][u] 正好是上面的 dJ/dadJ/da。

The value does not depend on x0x_0, provided the characteristic from x0x_0 enters the shock before TT. The left characteristic x0+uLtx_0+u_Lt reaches the shock exactly at t=Tt=T from x0=a+(s−uL)T=0.296x_0=a+(s-u_L)T=0.296, the right one from a+(s−uR)T=0.446a+(s-u_R)T=0.446; the plateau lies between them. For G=uG=u the plateau is continuous with both sides (value 1.446); for G=u2/2G=u^2/2 the plateau value is 0.723 while the sides are q(x+T)q(x+T) and 0, with two jumps. The plateau value times [u][u] is exactly the dJ/dadJ/da above.

逐步推导：稀疏波的导数

Step by step: the derivative of the rarefaction

稀疏波有三段：扇区外两段常值，扇区内 u=(x−a)/Tu=(x-a)/T。三段的积分限都随 aa 移动：

The rarefaction has three pieces: constants outside the fan and u=(x−a)/Tu=(x-a)/T inside it. All the limits move with aa:

J(a)=G(uL)∫0xLq dx+∫xLxRq(x) G(x−aT)dx+G(uR)∫xR1q dx,xL,R=a+uL,RT.\begin{gathered}J(a)=G(u_L)\int_0^{x_L}q\,dx+\int_{x_L}^{x_R}q(x)\,G\Bigl(\frac{x-a}T\Bigr)dx+G(u_R)\int_{x_R}^1q\,dx,\\x_{L,R}=a+u_{L,R}T.\end{gathered}

扇区边缘状态连续，G((xL−a)/T)=G(uL)G((x_L-a)/T)=G(u_L)，所以 Leibniz 公式产生的四个边界项两两抵消，只剩被积函数对 aa 的导数；再令 ξ=(x−a)/T\xi=(x-a)/T：

The state is continuous at the fan edges, G((xL−a)/T)=G(uL)G((x_L-a)/T)=G(u_L), so the four boundary terms of the Leibniz rule cancel in pairs and only the derivative of the integrand remains; then set ξ=(x−a)/T\xi=(x-a)/T:

dJda=−1T∫xLxRq(x) G′(x−aT)dx=−∫uLuRq(a+Tξ) G′(ξ) dξ.\begin{aligned}\frac{dJ}{da}&=-\frac1T\int_{x_L}^{x_R}q(x)\,G'\Bigl(\frac{x-a}T\Bigr)dx\\&=-\int_{u_L}^{u_R}q(a+T\xi)\,G'(\xi)\,d\xi.\end{aligned}

对 q=1+xq=1+x、uL=−uRu_L=-u_R：G=uG=u 时为 −(1+a)(uR−uL)=−1.371-(1+a)(u_R-u_L)=-1.371；G=u2/2G=u^2/2 时奇次项相消，只剩 −T∫ξ2dξ=−T(uR3−uL3)/3=−0.0125-T\int\xi^2d\xi=-T(u_R^3-u_L^3)/3=-0.0125。这些值就是 B.7 实验结果表中“连续位置导数”一行的数。

For q=1+xq=1+x and uL=−uRu_L=-u_R: G=uG=u gives −(1+a)(uR−uL)=−1.371-(1+a)(u_R-u_L)=-1.371; for G=u2/2G=u^2/2 the odd terms cancel and only −T∫ξ2dξ=−T(uR3−uL3)/3=−0.0125-T\int\xi^2d\xi=-T(u_R^3-u_L^3)/3=-0.0125 remains. These are the values in the “Continuous position derivative” row of the B.7 results table.

还要区分另一种适定性问题：对稳态、无源的 (1,−1) 问题，左右通量相同，很多激波位置都满足相同边界数据，位置没有被唯一选定。其平移方向可能对应零模，稳态线性化可能奇异。这里的非定常问题通过初始位置 a 选定轨迹，因此不能用稳态的不唯一性否定当前离散时间程序的求导。

A separate well-posedness issue arises for the source-free steady (1,−1) problem. Equal boundary fluxes admit multiple shock positions; translation may form a null mode and make the steady linearisation singular. The transient initial position a selects a trajectory. Steady nonuniqueness therefore does not invalidate differentiation of this specified discrete time program.

Giles 与 Ulbrich（2010，第二部分）研究了激波处离散伴随的收敛，并展示了原始解收敛而伴随平台不正确的情形；其证明针对特定数值耗散及随加密增长的激波覆盖点数。本附录的固定 α、minmod 方法不自动满足该定理的假设。因此下方同时显示离散验证和连续参考误差，不把前者当作后者的证明。

Giles and Ulbrich (2010, Part II) analyse discrete-adjoint convergence at shocks and exhibit incorrect adjoint plateaux despite primal convergence. Their proof uses particular dissipation scaling and an increasing number of points across the shock under refinement. That theorem does not automatically cover this fixed-α, minmod scheme. The experiment reports discrete verification separately from error against the continuous reference.

B.7 可执行实验：网格、限幅、时间反传和差分

B.7 Executable experiment: mesh, limiter, reverse time and FD

误差表中的 L1 是 hΣ|uᵢ−精确单元平均ᵢ|，不是对分片常值数值解与点态精确解之差的连续积分；实测阶为 log₂(ENE_N/E2NE_{2N})。两种误差在切过激波的单元中不同。图中的连续伴随参考按单元中心采样。分支改变数统计的是任一 RK 子阶段发生变化的时间层，而不是改变的单元总数。

The tabulated L1 error is hΣ|uᵢ−exact cell averageᵢ|, not the continuous integral of the error between a piecewise-constant numerical field and the pointwise exact solution. Observed order is log₂(ENE_N/E2NE_{2N}); these error definitions differ in shock-cut cells. The continuous-adjoint reference is sampled at cell centres. Branch-change counts refer to time levels with a change in either RK stage, not the total number of switched cells.

使用顺序：先比较两种空间离散的原始解和网格细化误差；再拖动时间层，看 tangent 如何集中到激波附近、伴随如何反向形成平台；最后改变 a（也可输入恰好位于网格面的数），比较单侧差分与中心差分。限幅分支改变的时间层数仅作诊断：小数值尾部的分支变化不一定显著影响目标，但不能忽略真实的不光滑点。

Suggested sequence: compare primal solutions and refinement errors for both spatial schemes; move the time slider to see tangent concentration and reverse-time adjoint evolution; then vary a, including positions exactly on mesh faces, and compare one-sided and central differences. The count of time levels with changed limiter branches is diagnostic: switches in tiny numerical tails need not affect the objective significantly, but actual nonsmooth points cannot be ignored.

B.8 小结与实现范围

B.8 Summary and implementation scope

本附录完整实现了三个 Riemann 问题的守恒时间推进、初值位置 tangent、反向时间离散 adjoint，以及解析解、质量平衡、点积和步长扫描验证。它没有实现任意激波相互作用的连续伴随，也没有证明当前耗散下伴随随网格加密收敛。教学的主线仍是对实际离散程序建立可核查的伴随；简单连续解用于验证和揭示局限。走向工业非结构网格 RANS 时，同样要交代限幅、边界、湍流闭合和求解过程的具体求导约定，不能假定存在一个可直接作为严格基准的完整连续伴随。

This appendix implements conservative time integration, initial-position tangents, reverse-time discrete adjoints, and analytic-solution, mass-balance, dot-product and step-size checks for three Riemann problems. It does not implement continuous adjoints for arbitrary shock interactions or prove adjoint convergence for this dissipation. The teaching focus remains an auditable adjoint of the actual discrete program. Simple continuous solutions expose both agreement and limitations. Industrial unstructured RANS additionally requires explicit differentiation conventions for limiters, boundaries, turbulence closure and solver operations; a complete continuous adjoint cannot simply be assumed to provide a rigorous reference.

/* Appendix B: conservative unsteady cell averages, selected-branch JVP/VJP. */
(function(root){'use strict';
const zeros=n=>Array(n).fill(0),dot=(a,b)=>a.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*b[i],0);
const cases={shock:[1,0],stationary:[1,-1],fan:[-.5,.5]};
function model({n=80,T=.15,a=.371,kind='shock',order=1,alpha=1.2,objective='linear'}={}){
 if(![n,T,a,alpha].every(Number.isFinite)||!['linear','quadratic'].includes(objective)||!cases[kind]||![1,2].includes(order)||!Number.isInteger(n)||n<8||T<0||T>.25||a<.2||a>.6||alpha<1)throw Error('Invalid shock experiment');
 const [left,right]=cases[kind],h=1/n,x=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>(i+.5)*h),steps=T?Math.ceil(T/(.35*h/alpha)):0,dt=steps?T/steps:0;
 const G=u=>objective==='linear'?u:.5*u*u,Gp=u=>objective==='linear'?1:u,q=x=>1+x;
 function coordinate(position){const z=position/h,r=Math.round(z);return Math.abs(z-r)<=8*Number.EPSILON*Math.max(1,Math.abs(z))?r:z;}
 function initial(position=a){const z=coordinate(position);return x.map((_,i)=>right+(left-right)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,z-i)));}
 function initialDirection(position=a){const v=zeros(n);v[Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(coordinate(position)))]=(left-right)/h;return v;}
 function stage(u){
  const slope=zeros(n),weights=Array.from({length:n},()=>[]),branch=Array(n).fill('zero');let ties=0;
  if(order===2)for(let i=1;i<n-1;i++){
   const l=u[i]-u[i-1],r=u[i+1]-u[i];
   if(l*r<=0){if(l===0||r===0)ties++;continue;}
   const pick=Math.abs(l)<=Math.abs(r);if(Math.abs(l)===Math.abs(r))ties++;
   slope[i]=pick?l:r;weights[i]=pick?[[i,1],[i-1,-1]]:[[i+1,1],[i,-1]];branch[i]=pick?'left':'right';
  }
  const flux=[],ca=[],cb=[];
  for(let f=0;f<=n;f++){const L=f?u[f-1]+.5*slope[f-1]:left,R=f<n?u[f]-.5*slope[f]:right;flux[f]=.25*(L*L+R*R)-alpha/2*(R-L);ca[f]=L/2+alpha/2;cb[f]=R/2-alpha/2;}
  return {u,slope,weights,branch,ties,flux,ca,cb,L:u.map((_,i)=>(flux[i]-flux[i+1])/h)};
 }
 function jvp(t,v){const ds=t.weights.map(w=>w.reduce((s,[j,c])=>s+c*v[j],0)),df=[];for(let f=0;f<=n;f++)df[f]=t.ca[f]*(f?v[f-1]+.5*ds[f-1]:0)+t.cb[f]*(f<n?v[f]-.5*ds[f]:0);return v.map((_,i)=>(df[i]-df[i+1])/h);}
 function vjp(t,w){const y=zeros(n),sb=zeros(n);for(let f=0;f<=n;f++){const eta=((f<n?w[f]:0)-(f?w[f-1]:0))/h;if(f){const b=t.ca[f]*eta;y[f-1]+=b;sb[f-1]+=.5*b;}if(f<n){const b=t.cb[f]*eta;y[f]+=b;sb[f]-=.5*b;}}for(let i=0;i<n;i++)for(const [j,c] of t.weights[i])y[j]+=c*sb[i];return y;}
 function run(position=a,keep=true){let u=initial(position);const history=keep?[u.slice()]:[],tape=[],branches=[];let conservation=0;
  for(let k=0;k<steps;k++){
   const A=stage(u),y=u.map((v,i)=>v+dt*A.L[i]),B=stage(y),next=u.map((v,i)=>.5*v+.5*(y[i]+dt*B.L[i]));
   const dm=h*next.reduce((s,v,i)=>s+v-u[i],0),boundary=dt/2*(A.flux[0]-A.flux[n]+B.flux[0]-B.flux[n]);conservation=Math.max(conservation,Math.abs(dm-boundary));
   branches.push(A.branch.join(',')+'|'+B.branch.join(','));if(keep)tape.push({A,B});u=next;if(keep)history.push(u.slice());
  }
  const J=h*u.reduce((s,v,i)=>s+q(x[i])*G(v),0);return {u,J,tape,history,branches,conservation};
 }
 function derivatives(run){let v=initialDirection(),tangent=[v.slice()];
  for(const {A,B} of run.tape){const av=jvp(A,v),vy=v.map((z,i)=>z+dt*av[i]),bv=jvp(B,vy);v=v.map((z,i)=>.5*z+.5*(vy[i]+dt*bv[i]));tangent.push(v.slice());}
  let w=run.u.map((u,i)=>h*q(x[i])*Gp(u));const dual=Array(steps+1);dual[steps]=w.slice();
  for(let k=steps-1;k>=0;k--){const {A,B}=run.tape[k],bw=vjp(B,w),wy=w.map((z,i)=>.5*z+.5*dt*bw[i]),aw=vjp(A,wy);w=w.map((z,i)=>.5*z+wy[i]+dt*aw[i]);dual[k]=w.slice();}
  return {tangent,dual,forward:dot(run.u.map((u,i)=>h*q(x[i])*Gp(u)),v),adjoint:dot(w,initialDirection())};
 }
 const speed=(left+right)/2;
 function exact(xx,time=T,position=a){if(time===0)return xx<position?left:right;if(left>right)return xx<position+speed*time?left:right;const z=(xx-position)/time;return z<left?left:z>right?right:z;}
 function integral(f,lo,hi){if(hi<=lo)return 0;const c=(lo+hi)/2,r=(hi-lo)/2,z=Math.sqrt(3/5);return r*(5/9*f(c-r*z)+8/9*f(c)+5/9*f(c+r*z));}

 const exactAverages=time=>x.map((_,i)=>exactIntegral((xx,u)=>u,i*h,(i+1)*h,time)/h);

 function continuousInitialDual(xx){if(left<=right)return null;const lo=a+(speed-left)*T,hi=a+(speed-right)*T;if(xx<lo)return q(xx+left*T)*Gp(left);if(xx>hi)return q(xx+right*T)*Gp(right);return q(a+speed*T)*(G(left)-G(right))/(left-right);}
 return {n,T,a,kind,order,alpha,objective,h,x,dt,steps,left,right,speed,G,Gp,initial,initialDirection,stage,jvp,vjp,run,derivatives,exact,exactAverages,referenceGradient,continuousInitialDual,exactJ:()=>exactIntegral((xx,u)=>q(xx)*G(u),0,1),aligned:Number.isInteger(coordinate(a))};

附录 C：显式矩阵与 LU 直接伴随求解

Appendix C: explicit matrices and direct LU adjoint solves

C.1 一阶和二阶都可以直接求解

C.1 Direct solves for both first and second order

本附录不采用 matrix-free 求解。先按顶端选定的一阶或二阶离散，显式组装完整 Jacobian A，再存储 Aᵀ 并进行带部分主元的 LU 分解，最后以前代和回代求出伴随。默认只有 8 个格心未知量或 9 个格点未知量；即使切换到 32 个网格区间，稠密直接法的成本也很小。正文的 matrix-free GS／GMRES 保留用于理解大型问题的求解方式。

This appendix does not use a matrix-free solve. Explicitly assemble the complete Jacobian A for the selected first- or second-order discretisation, store Aᵀ, factor it with partial-pivot LU, and compute the adjoint by forward/back substitution. The default grid has only eight cell or nine node unknowns; even 32 intervals remain a small dense problem. The main matrix-free GS/GMRES path remains available to explain methods for larger systems.

A=Ru(u∗,D),ATψ=−JuT,dJdD=JD+RDTψ.A=R_u(u^*,D),\qquad A^T\psi=-J_u^T,\qquad \frac{dJ}{dD}=J_D+R_D^T\psi.

C.2 按面显式组装完整矩阵

C.2 Explicit face-by-face matrix assembly

每个面先求左右重构权重和通量偏导 cL、cR，把 cL·左权重+cR·右权重加到左残差行、减到右残差行。二阶权重会延伸到更远的邻点，必须保留全部项。格点入口最后把第 0 行替换为 [1,0,…]。源项不依赖状态，因而不贡献 A；它仍通过 RDR_D 进入最终设计梯度。这里调用完整矩阵组装 matrix(u,false)，不使用一阶预处理近似。

For each face, evaluate reconstruction weights and flux partials cL,cR. Add cL times left weights plus cR times right weights to the left residual row and subtract them from the right row. Retain all extended second-order neighbours. On the node grid, replace row zero with [1,0,…] after assembly. The state-independent source contributes no A entries but still enters the design gradient through RDR_D. Use the complete assembly matrix(u,false), not the first-order preconditioner.

A = zeros(n,n)
for face f:
    q = face_values(u,f)
    for (row,sign) in [(left,+1),(right,-1)]:
        if row exists:
            for (j,w) in left_reconstruction:  A[row,j] += sign*q.cL*w
            for (j,w) in right_reconstruction: A[row,j] += sign*q.cR*w
if node_centred: A[0,:] = [1,0,...]
M = transpose(A)
LU, permutation = factor_with_partial_pivoting(M)
psi = triangular_solve(LU, permutation, -J_u)

C.3 LU 分解、行置换、前代与回代

C.3 LU factorisation, permutations and triangular solves

ΠAT=LU,Ly=Π(−JuT),Uψ=y.\Pi A^T=LU,\quad Ly=\Pi(-J_u^T),\quad U\psi=y.

每列从剩余行中选绝对值最大的主元，交换整行，并记录置换 Π。消元乘数保存在严格下三角 L（其对角线为 1），更新后的上三角保存 U。整行交换包括先前已经存储的 L 乘数；右端项也必须采用同一个置换。遇到数值奇异主元时报告失败，不人为替换零主元。不形成逆矩阵。

Choose the largest-magnitude remaining pivot in each column, swap whole rows and record Π. Store elimination multipliers below the diagonal (L has unit diagonal) and U on/above it. Full row swaps include previously stored L multipliers. Apply the same permutation to the right-hand side. Report numerically singular pivots instead of replacing zeros arbitrarily. Do not form a matrix inverse.

ℓik=mik/mkk,mij←mij−ℓikmkj,yi=(Πr)i−∑j<iℓijyj,ψi=(yi−∑j>iuijψj)/uii.\ell_{ik}=m_{ik}/m_{kk},\quad m_{ij}\leftarrow m_{ij}-\ell_{ik}m_{kj},\quad y_i=(\Pi r)_i-\sum_{j<i}\ell_{ij}y_j,\quad \psi_i=(y_i-\sum_{j>i}u_{ij}\psi_j)/u_{ii}.

下面的网格值、精确矩阵、消元步骤、置换右端、前代结果 y 和伴随 ψ 均现场计算。切换顶端阶数、网格数或入口闭合后自动重新组装和分解。消元步骤不是外层迭代，不存在 GS 意义下的收敛历史。

The mesh values, exact matrix, elimination steps, permuted right-hand side, intermediate y and adjoint ψ are computed live. Changing order, grid size or inlet closure automatically reassembles and refactors. Elimination stages are not outer iterations and do not form a GS convergence history.

逐步推导：一次分解同时服务 tangent 与 adjoint

Step by step: one factorisation serves both the tangent and the adjoint

本页分解的是 ATA^T。如果改为分解 AA，同一组因子也能解伴随：由 ΠA=LU\Pi A=LU 得 AT=UTLTΠA^T=U^TL^T\Pi，其中 UTU^T 是下三角、LTL^T 是单位上三角，所以伴随只是把两次三角求解的顺序和方向换过来：

This page factors ATA^T. Had it factored AA, the same factors would also solve the adjoint: ΠA=LU\Pi A=LU gives AT=UTLTΠA^T=U^TL^T\Pi, where UTU^T is lower triangular and LTL^T unit upper triangular, so the adjoint merely swaps the order and direction of the two triangular solves:

Ly=Πb,Uv=y⏟tangent Av=bUTz=r,LTy=z,ψ=ΠTy⏟adjoint ATψ=r.\underbrace{Ly=\Pi b,\quad Uv=y}_{\text{tangent }Av=b}\qquad\qquad \underbrace{U^Tz=r,\quad L^Ty=z,\quad \psi=\Pi^Ty}_{\text{adjoint }A^T\psi=r}.

分解本身约占 23n3\tfrac23n^3 次运算，每次三角求解对只需约 2n22n^2 次。多个目标函数（多个右端）共用一个 AA 时，只分解一次。

The factorisation costs about 23n3\tfrac23n^3 operations and each pair of triangular solves only about 2n22n^2. Several objectives (several right-hand sides) sharing one AA need one factorisation.

带状矩阵：本页的消元没有交换行，也没有填充

Banded matrices: on this page elimination swaps no rows and creates no fill

设 ATA^T 的下、上带宽为 pp、qq（一阶 p=q=1p=q=1，二阶 p=q=2p=q=2）。第 kk 步只有 pp 个乘数 ℓik=mik/mkk\ell_{ik}=m_{ik}/m_{kk} 非零，更新只触及 p×qp\times q 个元素，所以全程约 2npq2npq 次运算。部分主元若交换行，UU 的上带宽最多变为 p+qp+q。对本页的矩阵（格心，一阶与二阶，N=8N=8 与 3232），构建时的分解一次也没有交换行，LL 与 UU 的带宽与 ATA^T 相同，填充为零。这是对这些矩阵的计算结果，不是一般保证。

Let ATA^T have lower and upper bandwidths pp and qq (p=q=1p=q=1 at first order, p=q=2p=q=2 at second order). Step kk has only pp nonzero multipliers ℓik=mik/mkk\ell_{ik}=m_{ik}/m_{kk} and updates only p×qp\times q entries, so the whole factorisation costs about 2npq2npq operations. If partial pivoting swaps rows, the upper bandwidth of UU can grow to p+qp+q. For this page's matrices (cell, first and second order, N=8N=8 and 3232) the build-time factorisation never swapped a row: LL and UU keep the bandwidths of ATA^T and the fill is zero. This is a computed fact about these matrices, not a general guarantee.

C.4 小网格的速度、验证和适用范围

C.4 Small-grid performance, verification and scope

这里直接法求解阶段完全不调用 matrix-free 算子；求解完成后才用正文独立的反向算子检查真残差 Aᵀψ+JuTJ_u^T。同时比较 GS、GMRES 的伴随和全部设计梯度。计时包含直接法的精确矩阵组装、转置、LU 和三角求解；迭代法包含低阶预处理组装及求解。共享已收敛流场，不计原始求解和绘图，每种方法预热后测 7 次取中位数。

The direct solve itself never calls a matrix-free operator. Only afterwards does the main reverse operator independently check Aᵀψ+JuTJ_u^T. Compare adjoints and all gradients with GS and GMRES. Timing includes exact assembly, transpose, LU and triangular solves for the direct method, and low-order setup plus solution for iterative methods. Share the converged flow, exclude primal solves and rendering, warm up each method and report the median of seven runs.

η=∥ATψ+JuT∥∞∥AT∥∞∥ψ∥∞+∥JuT∥∞.\eta=\frac{\|A^T\psi+J_u^T\|_\infty}{\|A^T\|_\infty\|\psi\|_\infty+\|J_u^T\|_\infty}.

稠密存储为 O(n²)、LU 分解为 O(n³)、复用分解后每个新右端为 O(n²)。因此小系统直接法通常很快，但应以实测结果判断；计时分辨率、浏览器和求解器参数都会影响排名。若改变目标但保持同一个 A，可以复用 LU；若改变离散阶数或状态则必须重分解。工业大规模非结构网格系统需要考虑稀疏填充和内存，不能照搬稠密直接法。小后向误差也不等于病态系统具有小前向误差。

Dense storage costs O(n²), LU O(n³), and each new right-hand side with reused factors O(n²). Direct methods are often fast here, but the live measurements determine the ranking, which depends on timing resolution, browser and solver settings. Reuse LU for a new objective with unchanged A; refactor when order or state changes. Large industrial unstructured systems require attention to sparse fill and memory. Small backward error also does not guarantee small forward error in an ill-conditioned system.

逐步推导：后向误差为什么能换算成前向误差

Step by step: turning the backward error into a forward error

Rigal–Gaches 定理说明，上式的 η\eta 恰好是使 ψ\psi 成为某个扰动系统精确解的最小相对扰动：存在 EE、ff，

The Rigal–Gaches theorem says that η\eta above is exactly the smallest relative perturbation for which ψ\psi solves a perturbed system: there are EE and ff with

(AT+E)ψ=b+f,∥E∥≤η∥AT∥,∥f∥≤η∥b∥,b=−JuT.(A^T+E)\psi=b+f,\qquad \|E\|\le\eta\|A^T\|,\quad \|f\|\le\eta\|b\|,\qquad b=-J_u^T.

与精确解 ATψ∗=bA^T\psi^*=b 相减，得 AT(ψ−ψ∗)=f−EψA^T(\psi-\psi^*)=f-E\psi。两边乘 A−TA^{-T} 并取范数：

Subtracting the exact equation ATψ∗=bA^T\psi^*=b gives AT(ψ−ψ∗)=f−EψA^T(\psi-\psi^*)=f-E\psi. Multiply by A−TA^{-T} and take norms:

∥ψ−ψ∗∥∥ψ∥≤∥A−T∥ η(∥AT∥+∥b∥∥ψ∥)=κ(AT) η(1+∥b∥∥AT∥∥ψ∥)≲2 κ(AT) η.\frac{\|\psi-\psi^*\|}{\|\psi\|}\le\|A^{-T}\|\,\eta\Bigl(\|A^T\|+\frac{\|b\|}{\|\psi\|}\Bigr)=\kappa(A^T)\,\eta\Bigl(1+\frac{\|b\|}{\|A^T\|\|\psi\|}\Bigr)\lesssim2\,\kappa(A^T)\,\eta.

最后一步用了 ∥b∥=∥ATψ∗∥≤∥AT∥∥ψ∗∥≈∥AT∥∥ψ∥\|b\|=\|A^T\psi^*\|\le\|A^T\|\|\psi^*\|\approx\|A^T\|\|\psi\|。本页默认网格（格心，N=8N=8）：一阶 κ∞(AT)=17.3\kappa_\infty(A^T)=17.3、η=5.0×10−17\eta=5.0\times10^{-17}；二阶 κ∞(AT)=24.0\kappa_\infty(A^T)=24.0、η=6.5×10−17\eta=6.5\times10^{-17}。所以伴随的相对前向误差不超过约 3.1×10−153.1\times10^{-15}。条件数随网格加密增大（N=32N=32 时分别为 78 与 115），小后向误差并不自动意味着小前向误差。

The last step used ∥b∥=∥ATψ∗∥≤∥AT∥∥ψ∗∥≈∥AT∥∥ψ∥\|b\|=\|A^T\psi^*\|\le\|A^T\|\|\psi^*\|\approx\|A^T\|\|\psi\|. On this page's default mesh (cell, N=8N=8): first order κ∞(AT)=17.3\kappa_\infty(A^T)=17.3 and η=5.0×10−17\eta=5.0\times10^{-17}; second order κ∞(AT)=24.0\kappa_\infty(A^T)=24.0 and η=6.5×10−17\eta=6.5\times10^{-17}. The relative forward error of the adjoint is therefore at most about 3.1×10−153.1\times10^{-15}. The condition number grows under refinement (78 and 115 at N=32N=32), so a small backward error does not by itself mean a small forward error.

/* Explicit Burgers Jacobian assembly and partial-pivot LU: no matrix-free solve. */
(function(root){'use strict';const K=typeof module!=='undefined'?require('./core_1d'):root.FV1;
function factor(M,trace=false){const n=M.length,lu=M.map(r=>r.slice()),permutation=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i),steps=[],scale=Math.max(...M.flat().map(Math.abs));if(!scale||!Number.isFinite(scale))throw Error('Invalid or zero matrix');for(let k=0;k<n;k++){let pivot=k;for(let i=k+1;i<n;i++)if(Math.abs(lu[i][k])>Math.abs(lu[pivot][k]))pivot=i;if(Math.abs(lu[pivot][k])<=Number.EPSILON*scale*n)throw Error('Numerically singular LU pivot at '+k);[lu[k],lu[pivot]]=[lu[pivot],lu[k]];[permutation[k],permutation[pivot]]=[permutation[pivot],permutation[k]];for(let i=k+1;i<n;i++){lu[i][k]/=lu[k][k];for(let j=k+1;j<n;j++)lu[i][j]-=lu[i][k]*lu[k][j];}if(trace)steps.push({k,pivot,lu:lu.map(r=>r.slice()),permutation:permutation.slice()});}return {lu,permutation,steps};}
function solve(F,b){const {lu,permutation}=F,n=b.length,y=permutation.map(i=>b[i]),x=Array(n).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)for(let j=0;j<i;j++)y[i]-=lu[i][j]*y[j];for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--){let r=y[i];for(let j=i+1;j<n;j++)r-=lu[i][j]*x[j];x[i]=r/lu[i][i];}return {x,y,permutedRhs:permutation.map(i=>b[i])};}
const transpose=A=>A[0].map((_,j)=>A.map(r=>r[j]));

function adjoint(F,u,trace=false){const A=Array.from({length:F.N},()=>Array(F.N).fill(0));F.matrix(u,false).forEach((row,i)=>row.forEach(([j,v])=>A[i][j]=v));const AT=transpose(A),rhs=F.dJdu(u).map(v=>-v),fac=factor(AT,trace),s=solve(fac,rhs),res=F.vjp(u,s.x).map((v,i)=>v-rhs[i]),max=a=>Math.max(...a.map(Math.abs)),den=Math.max(...AT.map(r=>r.reduce((s,v)=>s+Math.abs(v),0)))*max(s.x)+max(rhs);return {...s,A,AT,rhs,fac,residual:K.norm(res),backwardError:den?max(res)/den:0,gradient:F.gradient(u,s.x)};}

附录 D：光滑性、limiter 与求导收敛

Appendix D: smoothness, limiters and derivative convergence

进阶教学 · 选读Advanced teaching · optional

本附录混合了已有概念演示与研究性参数实验。D.1 和 D.2 的完整／冻结导数区别可作为求导注意事项学习；D.3 的一般收敛机制、D.4 的联合极限分析可留到研究阶段。限制器收敛和间断解的伴随收敛已有研究，本页没有建立这些问题“尚未被研究”的结论。

This appendix mixes established demonstrations with research-oriented parameter experiments. D.1 and the full/frozen derivative distinction in D.2 teach differentiation caveats. General convergence mechanisms in D.3 and joint-limit analysis in D.4 can be left for research study. Limiter convergence and adjoint convergence for discontinuous solutions have existing literature; this page does not establish that these questions are unstudied.

先分辨四种不同问题：原始残差是否收敛、经典导数是否存在、固定线性系统是否解收敛、网格加密后是否逼近物理敏感度。实验不预设硬 limiter 必然发散，也不把光滑 limiter 当作收敛保证。

Separate four questions: convergence of the primal residual, existence of a classical derivative, convergence of a fixed linear solve, and approximation of physical sensitivities under refinement. A hard limiter need not diverge, and a smooth limiter does not guarantee convergence.

本附录独立于正文无黏源项模型，使用自己的参数和单元平均网格。格点页也显示相同的有限体积参考实验；不能把它误认为格点格式的验证。

This appendix has its own controls and cell-average grid, independent of the main inviscid source model. The node page displays the same finite-volume reference experiment; it is not validation of the node scheme.

D.1 光滑的线性分布，也会触及 minmod 切换

D.1 Even a smooth linear profile can reach a minmod switch

ui−1=uc−a,ui=uc+μ,ui+1=uc+a,si=minmod⁡(a+μ,a−μ)=a−∣μ∣(∣μ∣<a).u_{i-1}=u_c-a,\quad u_i=u_c+\mu,\quad u_{i+1}=u_c+a,\qquad s_i=\operatorname{minmod}(a+\mu,a-\mu)=a-|\mu|\quad(|\mu|<a).

μ=0 的左右导数分别为 +1 与 −1。程序相等时选择左分支，只给出该分支的线性化。中心差分得到零不代表导数存在。以下交互同时列出切换条件、局部 tangent 和反向累加权重。

At μ=0 the left and right derivatives are +1 and −1. The code selects the left branch at a tie, defining that branch’s linearization only. A zero central difference does not establish a derivative. Inspect the switch, local tangent and reverse accumulation weights below.

D.2 完整导数与冻结系数究竟差在哪里

D.2 Full derivatives versus frozen coefficients

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

链式法则中不能漏掉 limiter 的导数，是教学结论。下方光滑有理重构只是可微的对照模型；若进一步研究其 TVD、正性、离散熵稳定性、ε 与网格尺度的匹配，则属于未在本项目证明的格式分析。光滑不等于这些性质成立，也不等于 tangent／adjoint 必然收敛。

Retaining limiter derivatives in the chain rule is a teaching conclusion. The smooth rational reconstruction below is a differentiable comparison model. TVD, positivity, discrete entropy stability and scaling epsilon with the mesh require scheme analysis not proved in this project. Smoothness establishes none of those properties and does not guarantee tangent/adjoint convergence.

uf=ui+ϕiΔi,u˙f=u˙i+ϕiΔ˙i+Δiϕ˙i.u_f=u_i+\phi_i\Delta_i,\qquad \dot u_f=\dot u_i+\phi_i\dot\Delta_i+\Delta_i\dot\phi_i.

冻结 limiter 系数删除最后一项；保存 minmod 的分支仍应对分支内部运算完整求导。两者都可能通过各自的转置点积测试，但冻结系数一般不是原始残差的完整导数。为了明确对比，冻结模式保持基态重构值相同，只替换线性化；它没有重新定义一个全局相同的可微残差。

Freezing the coefficient drops the final term. Saving a minmod branch still differentiates all operations within that branch. Both maps may pass their own transpose test, while coefficient freezing generally is not the full residual derivative. The frozen mode preserves the base reconstruction value and replaces only its linearization; it does not define the same globally differentiable residual.

sε(a,b)=ab(a+b)a2+b2+ε2,ε>0.s_\varepsilon(a,b)=\frac{ab(a+b)}{a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2},\qquad \varepsilon>0.

光滑对照采用上述有理函数，对全部实数输入光滑；不再附加硬 min/max 或符号截断。它保持常值状态，但不是本页证明过的 TVD 或正性保持格式。ε 使用无量纲变量差分的尺度，改变 ε 就改变离散模型。Euler 若产生非正密度或压力、或超过固定耗散波速上界，将拒绝该状态而不静默裁剪。

The rational comparison is smooth for all real inputs, with no added hard min/max or sign clipping. It preserves constant states, but is not claimed to be TVD or positivity preserving. Epsilon uses the scale of nondimensional variable differences; changing it changes the discretization. Euler rejects nonpositive states or states beyond its fixed dissipation-speed bound rather than silently clipping them.

逐步推导：minmod 的单侧导数与有理限幅的导数

Step by step: the one-sided derivatives of minmod and the derivatives of the rational limiter

在 D.1 的线性分布上，两侧差为 a+μa+\mu 与 a−μa-\mu。∣μ∣<a|\mu|<a 时二者同号，minmod 取绝对值较小者：

On the linear profile of D.1 the two differences are a+μa+\mu and a−μa-\mu. For ∣μ∣<a|\mu|<a they have the same sign and minmod takes the smaller magnitude:

s(μ)=a−∣μ∣,s(τ)−s(−τ)2τ=0,lim⁡τ→0+s(τ)−s(0)τ=−1,lim⁡τ→0+s(0)−s(−τ)τ=+1.\begin{gathered}s(\mu)=a-|\mu|,\qquad \frac{s(\tau)-s(-\tau)}{2\tau}=0,\\\lim_{\tau\to0^+}\frac{s(\tau)-s(0)}{\tau}=-1,\qquad \lim_{\tau\to0^+}\frac{s(0)-s(-\tau)}{\tau}=+1.\end{gathered}

中心差分为零，却既不是左导数也不是右导数；程序在相等时选左分支 d=a+μd=a+\mu，返回的线性化是 +1+1。有理对照把两个差 aa、bb 放进一个商，求导用商法则：

The central difference is zero, yet it is neither one-sided derivative; the program picks the left branch d=a+μd=a+\mu at the tie and returns the linearisation +1+1. The rational comparison puts the two differences aa, bb into one quotient, differentiated by the quotient rule:

sε=Na2+b2+ε2,N=ab(a+b),∂sε∂a=b(2a+b)(a2+b2+ε2)−2a⋅ab(a+b)(a2+b2+ε2)2,∂sε∂b=a(a+2b)(a2+b2+ε2)−2b⋅ab(a+b)(a2+b2+ε2)2.\begin{gathered}s_\varepsilon=\frac{N}{a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2},\qquad N=ab(a+b),\\\frac{\partial s_\varepsilon}{\partial a}=\frac{b(2a+b)(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)-2a\cdot ab(a+b)}{(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)^2},\\\frac{\partial s_\varepsilon}{\partial b}=\frac{a(a+2b)(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)-2b\cdot ab(a+b)}{(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)^2}.\end{gathered}

在相等点 a=b=ma=b=m，两个偏导相同：(2m4+3m2ε2)/(2m2+ε2)2(2m^4+3m^2\varepsilon^2)/(2m^2+\varepsilon^2)^2，ε→0\varepsilon\to0 时趋于 12\tfrac12，也就是中心平均的导数。本页默认 ε=0.01\varepsilon=0.01、m=1m=1 时为 0.500020.50002。沿 D.1 的切片（两差为 a0+μa_0+\mu、a0−μa_0-\mu），dsε/dμ=∂asε−∂bsεds_\varepsilon/d\mu=\partial_as_\varepsilon-\partial_bs_\varepsilon 在 μ=0\mu=0 按对称性为零：有理函数没有尖点。minmod 在同一点的所选分支导数是 (∂a,∂b)=(1,0)(\partial_a,\partial_b)=(1,0)，与 (12,12)(\tfrac12,\tfrac12) 不同：两个模型在光滑单调区域也给出不同的线性化。

At the tie a=b=ma=b=m the two partials coincide: (2m4+3m2ε2)/(2m2+ε2)2(2m^4+3m^2\varepsilon^2)/(2m^2+\varepsilon^2)^2, which tends to 12\tfrac12, the derivative of the central average, as ε→0\varepsilon\to0. With this page's default ε=0.01\varepsilon=0.01 and m=1m=1 it equals 0.500020.50002. Along the slice of D.1 (differences a0+μa_0+\mu and a0−μa_0-\mu), dsε/dμ=∂asε−∂bsεds_\varepsilon/d\mu=\partial_as_\varepsilon-\partial_bs_\varepsilon vanishes at μ=0\mu=0 by symmetry: the rational function has no kink. The selected-branch derivative of minmod at the same point is (∂a,∂b)=(1,0)(\partial_a,\partial_b)=(1,0), not (12,12)(\tfrac12,\tfrac12): the two models linearise differently even in a smooth monotone region.

D.3 无激波稳态 Burgers：分支、矩阵和误差

D.3 Smooth steady Burgers: branches, matrices and errors

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

在同一固定状态上比较真实线性残差、冻结导数偏差和 LU／GS／GMRES，是进阶验证教学。把这些结果归因于 limiter 光滑性，并建立对网格、参数、预处理都成立的收敛判据，则属于研究。实验同时涉及离散算子与预处理质量，应控制变量；有限迭代预算未收敛、迭代矩阵范数大于 1，都不能单独证明渐近发散。

Comparing true linear residuals, frozen-derivative bias and LU/GS/GMRES at the same state is advanced verification teaching. Attributing those results to limiter smoothness and establishing criteria across meshes, parameters and preconditioners is research. Both the discrete operator and preconditioner quality matter, so control the comparison. Failure within a finite iteration budget or an iteration-matrix norm above one alone does not prove asymptotic divergence.

(12u2−νux)x=s(x,a),u∗(x)=1+asin⁡(2π(x−0.07)),a=0.2.\left(\tfrac12u^2-\nu u_x\right)_x=s(x,a),\quad u_*(x)=1+a\sin(2\pi(x-0.07)),\quad a=0.2.

两端给定解析 Dirichlet 值，源项积分由解析通量端点差计算。每次参数扰动都同时改变源项和边界，但数值未知量仍由残差求解，未填入解析解。设计变量为振幅 a，目标 J=hΣ(1+xᵢ)uᵢ。一阶与二阶使用相同 Rusanov 波速 2 和中心黏性通量；边界扩散距离为 h/2，首末单元不重构。

Both ends use analytic Dirichlet data; integrated sources are analytic physical-flux differences. Perturbations change sources and boundaries together, but unknowns are solved from residuals, never filled with the analytic profile. The design variable is amplitude a and J=hΣ(1+xᵢ)uᵢ. Both orders use Rusanov speed 2 and centred viscous fluxes; boundary diffusion distances are h/2, with no endpoint-cell reconstruction.

U = sampled reference as an initial guess only
repeat until ||R(U,a)|| is small:
    A = exact selected-branch Jacobian
    d = LU(A, -R)                 # small scalar experiment
    line-search U + step*d        # reject failed convergence
A v = -R_a;  A^T psi = -J_U^T
g = J_a + psi^T R_a
compare full-rerun FD, branch changes and LU/GS/GMRES

本标量实验用小矩阵 LU 及回溯得到原始状态，以隔离导数线性系统的求解困难。随后在同一个固定状态上比较 GS 缺陷校正、GS 预处理 GMRES 与 LU。精确算子通过计算图 JVP/VJP；一阶矩阵仅构造预处理，伴随使用整个预处理映射的转置。

This scalar experiment uses small-matrix LU and backtracking for the primal, isolating difficulty in derivative linear solves. At the same fixed state, compare GS defect correction, GS-preconditioned GMRES and LU. Exact actions use graph JVP/VJP; a first-order matrix builds the preconditioner, whose entire map is transposed for the adjoint.

Av=−Ra,ATψ=−JUT,ek+1=(I−ωBA)ek.A v=-R_a,\quad A^T\psi=-J_U^T,\quad e^{k+1}=(I-\omega BA)e^k.

GS 发散而 LU 后向残差很小，不能解释成“导数不存在”。反过来，求解器收敛也不能证明 minmod 切换点存在唯一导数。下方显示线性真残差、无穷范数条件数、迭代矩阵范数、原始分支变化和完整重算差分。没有计算精确谱半径：范数大于 1 不是发散证明。

GS divergence with a small LU backward residual does not establish nonexistence of a derivative. Conversely, linear convergence does not establish a unique derivative at a minmod switch. Inspect true residuals, infinity-norm conditioning, iteration-matrix norm, primal branch changes and full-rerun differences. Exact spectral radii are not computed: a norm above one is not proof of divergence.

D.4 固定物理时间：峰值增长还是求导失稳

D.4 Fixed physical time: concentration or derivative instability

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

这是本页最偏研究的部分：h→0、ν→0、δ→0 与 ε 的尺度选择涉及不同问题及极限顺序。固定 ν、δ 时的加密检验可用于教学；移动激波的分布型 tangent 也是已知概念。判断本格式在联合极限下是否收敛、以何种范数收敛、梯度是否正确，需要稳定性与极限分析。峰值增长或几组参数曲线不能代替该证明。

This is the most research-oriented part: h→0, ν→0, δ→0 and epsilon scaling involve different problems and orders of limits. Refinement at fixed viscosity and initial width is a teaching check; distributional tangents for moving shocks are also established. Determining convergence of this scheme in joint limits, its norm and gradient correctness requires stability and limiting analysis. Growing peaks or a few parameter curves do not replace that proof.

ut+(u2/2)x=νuxx,u(x,0)=12[1−tanh⁡(x−aδ)].u_t+(u^2/2)_x=\nu u_{xx},\qquad u(x,0)=\tfrac12\left[1-\tanh\left(\frac{x-a}{\delta}\right)\right].

独立非定常实验使用初值的精确单元平均，左／右外侧状态为 1／0，T=0.12。选择 ν、初始过渡层宽度 δ、网格及 limiter；只对位置 a=0.4 求导。SSP-RK2 的时间步数由网格、固定波速 1.5 和黏性稳定性上界确定，在位置差分中保持不变。所有 RK 子阶段的完整导数都进入 tangent 与反向时间 adjoint。

The independent transient experiment uses exact initial cell averages, exterior states 1/0 and T=0.12. Choose viscosity, initial width, grid and limiter; differentiate only position a=0.4. SSP-RK2 step count uses the mesh, fixed speed 1.5 and a viscous stability bound, and remains unchanged in position perturbations. Both RK stages contribute fully to the tangent and reverse-time adjoint.

U˙n+1=Φn,UU˙n,Uˉn=Φn,UTUˉn+1,UˉN=JUNT(vn≡U˙n).\dot U^{n+1}=\Phi_{n,U}\dot U^n,\qquad \bar U^n=\Phi_{n,U}^T\bar U^{n+1},\qquad \bar U^N=J_{U^N}^T\qquad(v^n\equiv\dot U^n).

黏性 ν 控制 PDE，ε 控制重构映射，δ 控制初始层宽度，三者不能混为一谈。先固定 ν、δ 加密，再改变 ν 或 δ。图同时显示 max|v|、hΣ|v| 和积分梯度；对于移动间断的无黏极限，tangent 可以集中为分布，峰值增大而积分敏感度仍有限。这里不给一般激波的连续伴随收敛保证。

Viscosity changes the PDE, epsilon changes reconstruction, and delta changes initial thickness. First refine at fixed viscosity and width, then vary one parameter. Compare max|v|, hΣ|v| and integral gradients. A moving discontinuity’s inviscid-limit tangent can concentrate as a distribution while integrated sensitivity stays finite. No general continuous-adjoint convergence guarantee is asserted.

逐步推导：初值导数为什么越来越尖

Step by step: why the initial derivative sharpens

对初值直接求导，tanh⁡\tanh 的导数是 sech⁡2\operatorname{sech}^2：

Differentiate the initial data directly; the derivative of tanh⁡\tanh is sech⁡2\operatorname{sech}^2:

∂u(x,0)∂a=12δsech⁡2(x−aδ),max⁡x∂u∂a=12δ,∫−∞∞∂u∂a dx=12[tanh⁡x−aδ]−∞∞=1.\begin{gathered}\frac{\partial u(x,0)}{\partial a}=\frac1{2\delta}\operatorname{sech}^2\Bigl(\frac{x-a}\delta\Bigr),\qquad \max_x\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}=\frac1{2\delta},\\\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}\,dx=\frac12\Bigl[\tanh\frac{x-a}\delta\Bigr]_{-\infty}^{\infty}=1.\end{gathered}

峰值与 1/δ1/\delta 成正比，面积却恒为 uL−uR=1u_L-u_R=1：δ→0\delta\to0 时导数趋于 [u]δ(x−a)[u]\delta(x-a)。离散初值用精确单元平均，单元 ii 的导数是 [tanh⁡((x−a)/δ)]xi−1/2xi+1/2/(2h)\bigl[\tanh((x-a)/\delta)\bigr]_{x_{i-1/2}}^{x_{i+1/2}}/(2h)，不超过 1/h1/h：峰值由 min⁡(1/(2δ),1/h)\min(1/(2\delta),1/h) 决定。所以“最大值随加密增大”是分布型导数的正常表现；应当检查的是积分量（例如 dJ/dadJ/da）是否收敛。

The peak is proportional to 1/δ1/\delta while the area stays uL−uR=1u_L-u_R=1: as δ→0\delta\to0 the derivative tends to [u]δ(x−a)[u]\delta(x-a). The discrete initial data use exact cell averages, whose derivative in cell ii is [tanh⁡((x−a)/δ)]xi−1/2xi+1/2/(2h)\bigl[\tanh((x-a)/\delta)\bigr]_{x_{i-1/2}}^{x_{i+1/2}}/(2h), at most 1/h1/h: the peak is set by min⁡(1/(2δ),1/h)\min(1/(2\delta),1/h). A maximum that grows under refinement is therefore normal for a distributional derivative; what must converge are integrated quantities such as dJ/dadJ/da.

D.5 阅读结果的顺序

D.5 How to interpret results

先检查原始真残差与状态有效性，再判断 limiter 分支和单侧导数，再比较同一个线性系统的 GS／GMRES／LU，最后进行网格加密及连续参考比较。两种转置矩阵有相同的二范数条件数；迭代差异要从预处理、右端项、非正规增长及停止标准解释，不能笼统归因于“伴随更不稳定”。

Check primal residual and admissibility first, then limiter branches and one-sided derivatives, then GS/GMRES/LU on the same system, and finally refinement against continuous references. A matrix and its transpose have the same 2-norm condition number; iteration differences require examining preconditioners, right-hand sides, nonnormal growth and stopping criteria, not a blanket claim that adjoints are less stable.

(function(root){'use strict';const N=typeof module!=='undefined'?require('./numerics'):root.EduNumerics,{real,zeros,norm}=N;
